```kt
import com.usbarsenal.app.backend.writeProfile
import com.usbarsenal.app.backend.writeText
import com.usbarsenal.app.backend.profileText
import com.usbarsenal.app.lcd.Lcd
import com.usbarsenal.app.lcd.LcdType
import com.usbarsenal.app.lcd.LocalHaptics
import com.usbarsenal.app.lcd.SpriteIcon
import com.usbarsenal.app.lcd.Sprites
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

// The power choices Identity offers, in mA; a profile written elsewhere may hold another
private val POWERS = listOf(100, 250, 500)

private val HEX4 = Regex("[0-9a-fA-F]{4}")

// What is wrong with a profile's fields, each by its field; nothing when it can be written
private fun hexInput(s: String) = s.filter { it in '0'..'9' || it in 'a'..'f' || it in 'A'..'F' }.take(4)

fun profileProblems(name: String, product: String, maker: String, vid: String, pid: String, taken: Boolean, serial: String = ""): Map<String, String> {
    val out = mutableMapOf<String, String>()
    val n = name.trim()
    if (n.isEmpty()) out["name"] = "a name for the file"
    else if (!Regex("[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 ._-]{0,63}").matches(n)) out["name"] = "letters, digits, space, . _ - only"
    else if (taken) out["name"] = "name taken"
    // As config.c's strings: printable ASCII only (USB strings are), 126 at most, and no '#',
    // which it reads as a comment after a space
    fun text(key: String, v: String, required: Boolean = true) {
        if (v.isBlank()) {
            if (required) out[key] = "cannot be empty"
        } else if (v.any { it !in ' '..'~' }) {
            out[key] = "plain ASCII letters, digits and symbols only"
        } else if ('#' in v) {
            out[key] = "no #"
        } else if (v.length > 126) {
            out[key] = "126 characters at most"
        }
    }
    text("product", product)
    text("maker", maker)
    // Empty is allowed: the phone's own serial
    text("serial", serial, required = false)
    if (!HEX4.matches(vid) || !HEX4.matches(pid)) out["ids"] = "four hex digits each"
    return out
}

/*
 * Identity: the profile the screen has picked, as a panel in the drive's look (its LED lit while
 * the host sees the gadget), and under a rule every profile in /sdcard/USB-Arsenal/Profiles,
 * Built-in first. A pick is set at once while nothing is bound; while the host sees the gadget it
 * waits, and Back asks to apply it (one replug) or discard it. Edit and Create share one sheet.
 */
@Composable
fun IdentityScreen(back: () -> Unit, openLog: () -> Unit) {
    // Until status and the profile in force are known, nothing is picked: an unknown gadget may
    // be live, and a pick set at once would replug it unasked
    val status = Gadget.status
    val known = status != null && Gadget.profile.isNotEmpty()
    val bound = status?.bound == true
    val active = activeProfile(Gadget.profile)
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var dir by remember { mutableStateOf(PROFILES) }
    // The folder as last listed, so the list and the panel are there from the first frame
    var profiles by remember { mutableStateOf(Cache.profiles?.let(::parseProfiles)) }
    var reload by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    LaunchedEffect(reload) {
        dir = profilesDir()
        listProfilesJson(dir)?.let {
            profiles = parseProfiles(it)
            Cache.profiles = it
        }
    }
    // A launch whose read of the profile in force failed asks again here, where it is needed
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { if (Gadget.profile.isEmpty()) Gadget.reloadProfile() }
    // The pick starts at what is in force, each time the screen opens and whenever that changes
    // under it (a set from the command line, a set that finished after Back)
    LaunchedEffect(active) {
        if (Gadget.profile.isEmpty()) return@LaunchedEffect
        IdentitySetup.chosen = active
        IdentitySetup.edited = false
        IdentitySetup.undo = null
    }
    val chosen = IdentitySetup.chosen
    // The one in force is known from `identity show` before the folder is listed
    val shown = if (chosen == null) BUILT_IN else profiles?.firstOrNull { it.path == chosen } ?: chosen.takeIf { it == active }?.let { profileOf(it, Gadget.profile) }
    var sheet by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val shake = rememberShake()
    val fault = Gadget.fault?.takeIf { it.identity }
    LaunchedEffect(fault) { if (fault != null) shake.fire() }
    val missing = Gadget.profile["missing"].orEmpty()

    // Set what is chosen: identity set, or unset for Built-in. A live gadget replugs once. A set
    // refused or failed leaves the pick on what is really in force, so the screen never shows
    // a profile the host does not get
    fun applyChosen() {
        val c = IdentitySetup.chosen
        val args = if (c == null) arrayOf("identity", "unset") else arrayOf("identity", "set", c)
        val accepted = Gadget.run(null, *args) { ok ->
            IdentitySetup.edited = false
            IdentitySetup.undo = null
            // The profile now in force, whatever happened: the effect above moves the pick to it
            Gadget.reloadProfile()
        }
        if (!accepted) {
            IdentitySetup.chosen = active
            IdentitySetup.edited = false
            IdentitySetup.undo = null
        }
    }
    fun pick(path: String?) {
        // Nothing is set before the gadget and the profile in force are known: say so
        if (!known) {
            Gadget.fault = Fault(null, "[-] The profile in force is not read yet", identity = true)
            return
        }
        IdentitySetup.chosen = path
        if (!bound && path != active) applyChosen()
    }
    // Leaving with a pick made while bound, the gadget since gone: nothing to replug, so it is set
    BackHandler {
        if (known && !bound && IdentitySetup.chosen != active) applyChosen()
        back()
    }

    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        Screen(
            footer = {
                KeyRow {
                    // Built-in is no file: there is nothing to edit
                    Key("Edit", Modifier.weight(1f).opener("identity/edit"), enabled = shown != null && chosen != null) { sheet = chosen }
                    Key("Create", Modifier.weight(1f).focusRequester(focusOn()).opener("identity/create"), primary = true) { sheet = "" }
                }
            },
        ) {
            Top { BackKey() }
            Title("Identity")
            ProfilePanel(shown, live = bound, Modifier.shake(shake))
            // Under the panel, which is what a set acts on
            fault?.let { Fault(it.message, onLog = openLog, modifier = Modifier.opener("identity/fault")) }
            if (missing.isNotEmpty() && fault == null) Warn("$missing is gone: the host gets Built-in")
            Column(Modifier.bleed(10.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
                FilesHeader(PROFILES, label = "Profiles")
                FileRow(BUILT_IN.name, "${BUILT_IN.vid}:${BUILT_IN.pid}", null, selected = chosen == null, onPick = { pick(null) })
                profiles.orEmpty().forEach { p ->
                    FileRow(p.name, "${p.vid}:${p.pid}", null, selected = p.path == chosen, onPick = { pick(p.path) })
                }
            }
        }
        NotAppliedSheet(
            identityPending(bound, chosen, active, IdentitySetup.edited),
            "The host still sees the old identity. Apply reconnects the gadget once; Discard keeps it.",
            canApply = Gadget.busy == null && !Gadget.backend.holds(),
            onDiscard = {
                IdentitySetup.chosen = active
                IdentitySetup.edited = false
                // An edit of the running profile is already in its file: put the old text back
                IdentitySetup.undo?.let { (path, text) -> IdentitySetup.restore(path, text) }
                IdentitySetup.undo = null
            },
            onApply = ::applyChosen,
            back = back,
        )
        ProfileSheet(
            open = sheet != null,
            profile = sheet?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { path -> profiles?.firstOrNull { it.path == path } },
            dir = dir,
            // Null while the list is unread: a new name cannot be checked, so Create waits
            names = profiles?.map { it.name.lowercase() },
            onDismiss = { sheet = null },
        ) { path, created, before ->
            sheet = null
            reload++
            when {
                created -> pick(path)
                // The running profile changed under the gadget: Back offers to apply it, and
                // Discard puts the old text back. Off the bus the link already reads the edit
                path == active && bound -> {
                    IdentitySetup.edited = true
                    if (IdentitySetup.undo == null && before != null) IdentitySetup.undo = path to before
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// The drive's look for a profile: an inverted face with its LED and name, the facts in the body
@Composable
private fun ProfilePanel(p: Profile?, live: Boolean, modifier: Modifier) {
    Panel(modifier = modifier, face = {
        LedDot(if (live) Led.BUSY else Led.ON)
        Text(p?.name ?: "", LcdType.labelStrong)
    }) {
        Row(
            // Four lines tall whether or not they are there yet, so it never grows under the list;
            // a larger font scale may make the lines themselves taller, so it is a floor
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 20.dp * 4 + Lcd.lines * 3 + 24.dp).padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top,
        ) {
            SpriteIcon(Sprites.Usb, 4.dp)
            if (p != null) {
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.lines)) {
                    Marquee(p.product, LcdType.data, Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                    Marquee(p.maker, LcdType.data, Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                    Text("${p.vid}:${p.pid} · ${p.power} mA", LcdType.data)
                    Marquee(p.serial.ifEmpty { "serial from this phone" }, LcdType.data, Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

private class Opened {
    var open = false
    var count = 0
    var profile: Profile? = null
}

/*
 * Create, or Edit: the Create-disk sheet's look. Name (locked when editing), product, maker,
 * serial (empty is the phone's own), the USB IDs and the power; each field says what is wrong
 * with it under it, and the key waits until nothing is.
 */
@Composable
private fun ProfileSheet(open: Boolean, profile: Profile?, dir: String, names: List<String>?, onDismiss: () -> Unit, onSaved: (String, Boolean, String?) -> Unit) {
    val haptics = LocalHaptics.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    /*
     * What the sheet opened on, held until it opens again. Closing clears [profile] at once, while
     * the sheet still slides away: without this it would show a blank Create on the way down.
     * Plain fields, not state: they only change in a composition that [open] already triggers.
     */
    val opened = remember { Opened() }
    if (open && !opened.open) {
        opened.count++
        opened.profile = profile
    }
    opened.open = open
    val editing = opened.profile
    val start = editing ?: BUILT_IN.copy(product = "", maker = "")
    // Each time the sheet opens, from the profile it opens on
    var name by remember(opened.count) { mutableStateOf(editing?.name ?: "") }
    var product by remember(opened.count) { mutableStateOf(start.product) }
    var maker by remember(opened.count) { mutableStateOf(start.maker) }
    var vid by remember(opened.count) { mutableStateOf(start.vid) }
    var pid by remember(opened.count) { mutableStateOf(start.pid) }
    var power by remember(opened.count) { mutableIntStateOf(start.power) }
    var serial by remember(opened.count) { mutableStateOf(start.serial) }
    var writing by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var failed by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val taken = editing == null && names != null && name.trim().lowercase() in names
    val problems = profileProblems(name, product, maker, vid, pid, taken, serial)
    val ids = KeyboardOptions(capitalization = KeyboardCapitalization.None, autoCorrectEnabled = false)

    fun save() {
        val path = editing?.path ?: "$dir/${name.trim()}.conf"
        writing = true
        failed = null
        scope.launch {
            val before = if (editing != null) profileText(path) else null
            val r = writeProfile(Profile(path, product.trim(), maker.trim(), vid.lowercase(), pid.lowercase(), power, serial.trim()), create = editing == null)
            writing = false
            if (r.ok) {
                haptics.confirm()
                onSaved(path, editing == null, before)
            } else {
                failed = r.why
                haptics.reject()
            }
        }
    }

    val cancelKey = remember { FocusRequester() }
    Sheet(
        open,
        onDismiss = { if (!writing) onDismiss() },
        entry = cancelKey,
        footer = {
            Key("Cancel", Modifier.weight(1f).focusRequester(cancelKey), enabled = !writing, onClick = onDismiss)
            Key(if (editing == null) "Create" else "Save", Modifier.weight(1f), primary = true, enabled = problems.isEmpty() && !writing && (editing != null || names != null)) { save() }
        },
    ) {
        Title(if (editing == null) "Create" else "Edit")
        Field("Name") { Input(name, { name = it.filter { c -> c in 'a'..'z' || c in 'A'..'Z' || c in '0'..'9' || c in " ._-" }.take(64) }, Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), placeholder = "pixel-8", enabled = editing == null) }
        problems["name"]?.takeIf { name.isNotEmpty() }?.let { Warn(it) }
        Field("Product") { Input(product, { product = usbText(it) }, Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), placeholder = "USB Arsenal") }
        problems["product"]?.takeIf { product.isNotEmpty() }?.let { Warn(it) }
        Field("Maker") { Input(maker, { maker = usbText(it) }, Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), placeholder = "USB Arsenal") }
        problems["maker"]?.takeIf { maker.isNotEmpty() }?.let { Warn(it) }
        // Left empty, the host sees the phone's own serial
        Field("Serial") { Input(serial, { serial = usbText(it) }, Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), placeholder = "from this phone") }
        problems["serial"]?.let { Warn(it) }
        Field("USB IDs") {
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Input(vid, { vid = hexInput(it) }, Modifier.width(96.dp), placeholder = "1d6b", keyboard = ids)
                Text(":", LcdType.data)
                Input(pid, { pid = hexInput(it) }, Modifier.width(96.dp), placeholder = "0104", keyboard = ids)
            }
        }
        problems["ids"]?.let { Warn(it) }
        // The unit in VT323 beside the segments: Silkscreen would print it as MA
        Field("Power") {
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.tight), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Segs(POWERS.map { "$it" }, POWERS.indexOf(power), { power = POWERS[it] }, Modifier.weight(1f), spoken = { "${POWERS[it]} milliamps" })
                Text("mA", LcdType.data)
            }
        }
        failed?.let { Fault(it, onLog = null) }
    }
}
```

```kt
/*
 * One root `hid write` per node, fed one report per pipe write (atomic below PIPE_BUF). It never
 * blocks on the node: while the host reads nothing it keeps only the newest report, so the host
 * ends in the latest state and no backlog lands when it wakes. f_hid holds one report at a time,
 * so a report written before the host took the last one replaces it: keys, where every press
 * and release counts, are [paced] (ms) to two poll periods apart, and none is ever dropped here.
 * Pointer moves may go: the newest carries the buttons as they are.
 */
private class HidWriter(private val node: String, private val size: Int, private val paced: () -> Long = { 0L }) {
    private val reports = if (paced() > 0) Channel<ByteArray>(Channel.UNLIMITED) else Channel(64, BufferOverflow.DROP_OLDEST)

    fun send(report: ByteArray) {
        reports.trySend(report)
    }

    // Runs until cancelled, which kills the writer with its shell. One that dies (HID stopped, the
    // host gone) breaks the pipe under the next report; another is started, and every start
    // first lets go of everything, so a release lost with the last one holds no key down
    suspend fun run() {
        while (true) {
            val w = hidWrite(node, size)
            if (w != null) {
                try {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                        w.input.write(ByteArray(size))
                        w.input.flush()
                        for (r in reports) {
                            w.input.write(r)
                            w.input.flush()
                            paced().takeIf { it > 0 }?.let { delay(it) }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (_: IOException) {
                } finally {
                    withContext(NonCancellable) { w.close() }
                }
            }
            delay(1000)
        }
    }
}

// Two poll periods of the running keyboard, in whole ms: its interval (0 is the kernel's 1 ms) at
// the bus speed the host gave it
private fun keyPace(): Long {
    val s = Gadget.status
    val n = s?.hid?.firstOrNull { it.function == "keyboard" }?.interval?.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: DEFAULT_INTERVAL
    val us = if (s?.speed == "full-speed") n * 1000L else (1L shl (n - 1)) * 125
    return maxOf(1L, (2 * us + 999) / 1000)
}

// The left stick while Keys + mouse holds it: MainActivity hands joystick moves here instead of
// letting them move focus
object Stick {
    var sink: ((Float, Float) -> Unit)? = null
}

private val KEY_H = Lcd.touch
private val KEY_GAP = 10.dp
private val FKEYS = (1..12).map { "F$it" }
private val TABLE = listOf(
    listOf("ESC", "TAB", "BKSP", "DEL"),
    listOf("SHIFT", "CTRL", "ALT", "SUPER"),
    listOf("INS", "HOME", "END", "PRTSC"),
    listOf("ENTER", "ENTER", "PGUP", "PGDN"),
)
private const val TYPE_LABEL = 20

// What the table names, for the test that every key shown has a code
internal val TABLE_NAMES = TABLE.flatten().toSet()

// Rows of keys, each [cols] wide; a name given twice in a row is one key two cells wide
private fun gridHeight(rows: Int) = KEY_H * rows + KEY_GAP * (rows - 1)

// The Keys tab above its TYPE box: F-keys, the table, the arrows, with the gaps between and the
// TYPE label. The Mouse tab's pad is this tall, so its bottom edge sits where the box begins
private val KEYS_ABOVE_BOX = gridHeight(2) + gridHeight(4) + gridHeight(2) + Lcd.section * 3 + TYPE_LABEL.dp + 6.dp

/*
 * Keys + mouse: the host's keyboard and mouse, live. Mouse is a trackpad with a wheel strip and
 * L M R; Keys is F1 to F12, the editing and modifier keys, the arrows and a box whose text goes
 * to the host as typed. Modifiers latch for the next key. The gamepad's left stick drives the
 * pointer, A and X click. With HID off, the page is shaded and asks for HID first.
 */
@Composable
fun KbdMouseScreen(back: () -> Unit) {
    BackHandler(onBack = back)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    // Kept through a status read that fails: one bad poll must not kill the writers
    val status = Gadget.status
    var hid by remember { mutableStateOf(status?.hid.orEmpty()) }
    LaunchedEffect(status) { if (status != null) hid = status.hid }
    val kbdNode = hid.firstOrNull { it.function == "keyboard" }?.node?.ifEmpty { null }
    val mouseNode = hid.firstOrNull { it.function == "mouse" }?.node?.ifEmpty { null }
    val on = kbdNode != null && mouseNode != null
    val kbd = remember(kbdNode) { kbdNode?.let { HidWriter(it, 8, ::keyPace) } }
    val mouse = remember(mouseNode) { mouseNode?.let { HidWriter(it, 4) } }
    LaunchedEffect(kbd) { kbd?.run() }
    LaunchedEffect(mouse) { mouse?.run() }

    var tab by rememberSaveable { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var buttons by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var mods by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    fun pointer(dx: Int = 0, dy: Int = 0, wheel: Int = 0) = mouse?.send(mouseReport(buttons, dx, dy, wheel))
    fun button(bit: Int, down: Boolean) {
        buttons = if (down) buttons or bit else buttons and bit.inv()
        pointer()
    }
    // A key goes with the latched modifiers, then they let go: Ctrl, then c, is Ctrl+C
    fun press(code: Int, extra: Int = 0) {
        kbd?.send(keyReport(mods or extra, code))
        kbd?.send(keyReport())
        mods = 0
    }

    // The left stick moves the pointer a frame at a time while held past its dead zone
    var stick by remember { mutableStateOf(Offset.Zero) }
    DisposableEffect(on) {
        Stick.sink = if (on) { x, y -> stick = Offset(x, y) } else null
        onDispose { Stick.sink = null }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(on) {
        while (on) {
            delay(FRAME_MS.toLong())
            val (x, y) = stick
            if (abs(x) > 0.15f || abs(y) > 0.15f) pointer((x * 14).roundToInt(), (y * 14).roundToInt())
        }
    }

    // A phone held sideways: the Mouse tab cannot fit, so the whole screen scrolls instead, by the
    // title, the tabs or a label (the pad and L M R keep their own gestures)
    val windowHeight = with(LocalDensity.current) { LocalWindowInfo.current.containerSize.height.toDp() }
    val short = windowHeight < 600.dp
    // Full screen: the pad and L M R alone, landscape, the system bars hidden. Only while HID runs:
    // a restore asks for it again, and it shows once HID is known to run, never before
    var wantFull by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val full = wantFull && on
    var wasOn by remember { mutableStateOf(on) }
    LaunchedEffect(on) {
        if (wasOn && !on) wantFull = false
        wasOn = on
    }
    // Turning the phone sideways on the Mouse tab is asking for the wide pad. Only on the turn, so
    // leaving full screen while still sideways stays left (the page then scrolls)
    LaunchedEffect(short) { if (short && on && tab == 0) wantFull = true }
    // L M R are drawn anew on the way in or out, and a button held then would never let go
    LaunchedEffect(full) {
        if (buttons != 0) {
            buttons = 0
            pointer()
        }
    }
    BackHandler(enabled = full) { wantFull = false }
    val activity = LocalActivity.current
    val view = LocalView.current
    // The screen gives back the orientation it found when it leaves
    DisposableEffect(activity) {
        val was = activity?.requestedOrientation
        onDispose { if (activity != null && was != null) activity.requestedOrientation = was }
    }
    DisposableEffect(full) {
        val window = activity?.window
        if (!full || activity == null || window == null) return@DisposableEffect onDispose {}
        val bars = WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, view)
        val was = activity.requestedOrientation
        // How it was held: portrait or landscape, and which way up
        val portrait = activity.resources.configuration.orientation != Configuration.ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        val flipped = view.display?.rotation.let { it == Surface.ROTATION_180 || it == Surface.ROTATION_270 }
        // An edge swipe shows the bars for a moment over the pad, then they hide again
        bars.systemBarsBehavior = WindowInsetsControllerCompat.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
        bars.hide(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars())
        activity.requestedOrientation = ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_SENSOR_LANDSCAPE
        onDispose {
            bars.show(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars())
            // With auto-rotate off, the landscape request moved the locked rotation, and giving
            // the request back would leave the phone sideways: ask for the way it was held instead
            val autoRotate = Settings.System.getInt(activity.contentResolver, Settings.System.ACCELEROMETER_ROTATION, 0) == 1
            activity.requestedOrientation = when {
                autoRotate -> was
                portrait && flipped -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_REVERSE_PORTRAIT
                portrait -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT
                flipped -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_REVERSE_LANDSCAPE
                else -> ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
            }
        }
    }
    val pad = @Composable { modifier: Modifier, onFull: (() -> Unit)? ->
        Trackpad(
            modifier,
            HidSetup.speed,
            HidSetup.natural,
            onMove = { dx, dy -> pointer(dx, dy) },
            onTap = {
                button(MOUSE_LEFT, true)
                button(MOUSE_LEFT, false)
            },
            onWheel = { pointer(wheel = it) },
            onButton = { bit, down -> if (on) button(bit, down) },
            onFull = onFull,
        )
    }
    // Keys typed into the box, kept here so a trip to the Mouse tab never empties it
    var text by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        if (full) {
            Column(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .background(LocalLcd.current.ground)
                    .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing)
                    .padding(Lcd.gutter),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.tight),
            ) {
                // A drag from the side edges is the pad's, not the system's Back gesture
                pad(Modifier.weight(1f).systemGestureExclusion(), null)
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.tight), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Key(
                        "Leave full screen",
                        Modifier.width(56.dp),
                        icon = Sprites.Collapse,
                        padding = 0.dp,
                    ) { wantFull = false }
                    Box(Modifier.weight(1f)) { MouseButtons { bit, down -> button(bit, down) } }
                }
            }
        } else Screen(scroll = tab == 0 && short) {
            Top { BackKey() }
            Title("Keys + mouse")
            Segs(listOf("Mouse", "Keys"), tab, { tab = it })
            if (tab == 0) {
                BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                    // The pad takes what L M R, the rule, Speed and Natural scroll leave, up to the
                    // Keys tab's height above its box; a short screen (landscape) gets the floor
                    // L M R, CONFIGURE (a 20dp line and its 4dp top), Speed and Natural scroll, 4 gaps
                    val below = Lcd.touch + Lcd.pixel * 4 + 24.dp + Lcd.touch * 2 + Lcd.section * 4
                    val padHeight = if (maxHeight == Dp.Infinity) {
                        (windowHeight / 2).coerceIn(120.dp, KEYS_ABOVE_BOX)
                    } else {
                        KEYS_ABOVE_BOX.coerceAtMost(maxHeight - below).coerceAtLeast(120.dp)
                    }
                    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.section)) {
                        pad(Modifier.height(padHeight), if (on) ({ wantFull = true }) else null)
                        MouseButtons { bit, down -> button(bit, down) }
                        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.section)) {
                            Group("Configure")
                            val speed = HidSetup.speed
                            Slider("Speed", speed, 1..16, if (speed % 4 == 0) "${speed / 4}.0x" else "${speed / 4f}x", { HidSetup.speed(it) })
                            Kv("Natural scroll") { Dip(HidSetup.natural, { HidSetup.natural(it) }, "Natural scroll") }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                KeysTab(text, { text = it }, mods, onMod = { mods = mods xor it }, onKey = { press(it) }, onType = { m, c -> press(c, m) })
            }
        }
        if (!on) HidOff(Gadget.caps.has(Fn.HID))
    }
}

/*
 * .pad: a .d25 panel where a drag moves the host pointer and a tap clicks, with the pointer
 * drawn where the finger is, and a 44dp wheel strip on its right. A tick every 8dp of travel,
 * as DESIGN.md's haptics table says, so a drag is felt without buzzing.
 */
@Composable
private fun Trackpad(
    modifier: Modifier,
    speed: Int,
    natural: Boolean,
    onMove: (Int, Int) -> Unit,
    onTap: () -> Unit,
    onWheel: (Int) -> Unit,
    // A gamepad's A and X while the pad has focus: a left and a right button, held as long as they are
    onButton: (Int, Boolean) -> Unit,
    // Set: the key into full screen, in the pad's top-left corner
    onFull: (() -> Unit)?,
) {
    // The gestures outlive a recomposition; they must reach the writer, and use the setup, as it is now
    val quarters by rememberUpdatedState(speed)
    val follow by rememberUpdatedState(natural)
    val move by rememberUpdatedState(onMove)
    val tap by rememberUpdatedState(onTap)
    val wheel by rememberUpdatedState(onWheel)
    val ink = LocalLcd.current.ink
    val haptics = LocalHaptics.current
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    val tickPx = with(density) { 8.dp.toPx() }
    val stepPx = with(density) { 16.dp.toPx() }
    var at by remember { mutableStateOf<Offset?>(null) }
    val button by rememberUpdatedState(onButton)
    var padFocused by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var wheelFocused by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    Row(modifier.fillMaxWidth().border(Lcd.pixel, ink)) {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .weight(1f)
                .fillMaxHeight()
                // The first stop, so a gamepad has the pad from the start: A and X click only over it,
                // and Enter or A on anything else presses that instead
                .focusRequester(focusOn())
                .onFocusChanged { padFocused = it.isFocused }
                .onKeyEvent {
                    val bit = when (it.key) {
                        KeyCode.ButtonA, KeyCode.Enter, KeyCode.DirectionCenter -> MOUSE_LEFT
                        KeyCode.ButtonX -> MOUSE_RIGHT
                        else -> return@onKeyEvent false
                    }
                    if (it.type == KeyEventType.KeyDown && it.nativeKeyEvent.repeatCount == 0) haptics.keyPress()
                    button(bit, it.type == KeyEventType.KeyDown)
                    true
                }
                .focusTick()
                .focusable()
                .then(if (padFocused) Modifier.focusOutline(ink) else Modifier)
                .dither(Dither.D25, LocalLcd.current)
                .pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures(onTap = { at = it; tap() }) }
                .pointerInput(Unit) {
                    // Half a pixel of host travel per pixel of drag at 1.0x (4 quarters), the
                    // remainder carried over
                    var rx = 0f
                    var ry = 0f
                    var travel = 0f
                    detectDragGestures(onDragStart = { at = it }) { change, d ->
                        change.consume()
                        at = change.position
                        rx += d.x * quarters / 8
                        ry += d.y * quarters / 8
                        val dx = rx.toInt()
                        val dy = ry.toInt()
                        rx -= dx
                        ry -= dy
                        if (dx != 0 || dy != 0) move(dx, dy)
                        travel += d.getDistance()
                        if (travel >= tickPx) {
                            travel = 0f
                            haptics.frequentTick()
                        }
                    }
                },
        ) {
            at?.let { p ->
                SpriteIcon(
                    Sprites.Pointer, 2.dp,
                    Modifier.offset { IntOffset(p.x.roundToInt(), p.y.roundToInt()) }.background(LocalLcd.current.ground).padding(2.dp),
                )
            }
            if (onFull != null) {
                Key(
                    "Full screen",
                    Modifier.padding(6.dp).size(Lcd.touch),
                    icon = Sprites.Expand,
                    padding = 0.dp,
                    onClick = onFull,
                )
            }
        }
        Column(
            Modifier
                .width(44.dp)
                .fillMaxHeight()
                // Up and Down turn the wheel a step while it has focus, as a drag of 16dp does
                .onFocusChanged { wheelFocused = it.isFocused }
                .onKeyEvent {
                    val up = it.key == KeyCode.DirectionUp
                    if (it.type != KeyEventType.KeyDown || !(up || it.key == KeyCode.DirectionDown)) return@onKeyEvent false
                    wheel(if (up) 1 else -1)
                    haptics.frequentTick()
                    true
                }
                .focusTick()
                .focusable()
                .then(if (wheelFocused) Modifier.focusOutline(ink) else Modifier)
                .background(LocalLcd.current.ground)
                // The 2dp rule between the strip and the pad
                .drawBehind { drawRect(ink, size = Size(Lcd.pixel.toPx(), size.height)) }
                .pointerInput(Unit) {
                    var acc = 0f
                    detectVerticalDragGestures { change, dy ->
                        change.consume()
                        acc += dy
                        while (abs(acc) >= stepPx) {
                            // Dragging up scrolls up, as a wheel turned away does; natural scroll
                            // moves the content with the finger instead, as a touchscreen does
                            val up = acc < 0
                            acc += if (up) stepPx else -stepPx
                            wheel(if (up != follow) 1 else -1)
                            haptics.frequentTick()
                        }
                    }
                }
                .padding(vertical = 6.dp),
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
            Text("^", LcdType.labelStrong)
            // The wheel's track: a dashed 6dp line, as the tether wires are drawn
            Box(Modifier.weight(1f).padding(vertical = 6.dp).width(6.dp).dashes(ink))
            Text("v", LcdType.labelStrong)
        }
    }
}

/*
 * L M R: a button is down for as long as it is held, so a hold drags on the host. Down and up
 * follow the press events themselves, not what is drawn, so a press shorter than a frame still
 * clicks; a click with no press (TalkBack) is a down and an up at once.
 */
@Composable
private fun MouseButtons(onButton: (Int, Boolean) -> Unit) {
    val ink = LocalLcd.current.ink
    val haptics = LocalHaptics.current
    val button by rememberUpdatedState(onButton)
    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().border(Lcd.pixel, ink).padding(Lcd.pixel)) {
        listOf("L" to MOUSE_LEFT, "M" to MOUSE_MIDDLE, "R" to MOUSE_RIGHT).forEachIndexed { i, (label, bit) ->
            if (i > 0) Box(Modifier.width(Lcd.pixel).height(Lcd.touch).background(ink))
            val interaction = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
            val pressed by interaction.collectIsPressedAsState()
            var fromPress by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
            LaunchedEffect(interaction) {
                interaction.interactions.collect {
                    when (it) {
                        is PressInteraction.Press -> {
                            fromPress = true
                            haptics.keyPress()
                            button(bit, true)
                        }
                        is PressInteraction.Release -> button(bit, false)
                        is PressInteraction.Cancel -> {
                            fromPress = false
                            button(bit, false)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Inverted(pressed) {
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .weight(1f)
                        .heightIn(min = Lcd.touch)
                        .background(LocalLcd.current.ground)
                        .lcdClickable(interaction, outline = true, role = Role.Button) {
                            if (fromPress) {
                                fromPress = false
                            } else {
                                haptics.keyPress()
                                button(bit, true)
                                button(bit, false)
                            }
                        },
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                ) { Text(label, LcdType.labelStrong) }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun KeysTab(text: String, onText: (String) -> Unit, mods: Int, onMod: (Int) -> Unit, onKey: (Int) -> Unit, onType: (Int, Int) -> Unit) {
    BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        // The box takes what the keys leave, and keeps a few lines when the keyboard is up
        val box = (maxHeight - KEYS_ABOVE_BOX).coerceAtLeast(120.dp)
        Column(Modifier.lcdScroll(rememberScrollState()), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.section)) {
            KeyGrid(listOf(FKEYS.take(6), FKEYS.drop(6)), mods, onMod, onKey)
            KeyGrid(TABLE, mods, onMod, onKey)
            KeyGrid(listOf(listOf("", "UP", ""), listOf("LEFT", "DOWN", "RIGHT")), mods, onMod, onKey)
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                Text("Type", LcdType.labelStrong, Modifier.height(TYPE_LABEL.dp))
                Input(
                    text,
                    { input ->
                        // The box holds only what the host was sent, so a Backspace always erases
                        // a character the host has: what no key types (é, emoji) never goes in
                        val next = input.filter { keyFor(it) != null }
                        // What changed goes to the host: Backspace for what went, keys for what came
                        val same = text.commonPrefixWith(next).length
                        repeat(text.length - same) { onKey(NAMED_KEYS.getValue("BKSP")) }
                        next.drop(same).forEach { c -> keyFor(c)?.let { (m, code) -> onType(m, code) } }
                        onText(next.takeLast(2000))
                    },
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(box),
                    keyboard = KeyboardOptions(capitalization = KeyboardCapitalization.None, autoCorrectEnabled = false, keyboardType = KeyboardType.Ascii),
                    singleLine = false,
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

internal fun runs(row: List<String>): List<Pair<String, Float>> =
    row.fold(mutableListOf<Pair<String, Float>>()) { out, name ->
        if (name.isNotEmpty() && out.lastOrNull()?.first == name) out[out.lastIndex] = name to out.last().second + 1 else out += name to 1f
        out
    }

// A grid of keys: modifiers latch (inverted while latched), the rest press and release
@Composable
private fun KeyGrid(rows: List<List<String>>, mods: Int, onMod: (Int) -> Unit, onKey: (Int) -> Unit) {
    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(KEY_GAP)) {
        rows.forEach { row ->
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(KEY_GAP)) {
                // A name repeated side by side is one key that many cells wide; an empty name is a gap
                runs(row).forEach { (name, span) ->
                    if (name.isEmpty()) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.weight(span))
                        return@forEach
                    }
                    val mod = MODIFIERS[name]
                    val arrow = when (name) {
                        "UP" -> Sprites.ArrowUp
                        "DOWN" -> Sprites.ArrowDown
                        "LEFT" -> Sprites.ArrowLeft
                        "RIGHT" -> Sprites.ArrowRight
                        else -> null
                    }
                    Key(
                        name,
                        Modifier.weight(span),
                        primary = mod != null && mods and mod != 0,
                        padding = 2.dp,
                        icon = arrow,
                        minHeight = KEY_H,
                    ) { if (mod != null) onMod(mod) else onKey(NAMED_KEYS.getValue(name)) }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// HID off: the page shaded, Pin asking for HID first, or saying this kernel has none, as Home's row does
@Composable
private fun HidOff(kernelHas: Boolean) = Shade(if (kernelHas) "Enable HID on Home\nto use this page" else "No HID in\nthis kernel") { Pin(3.dp) }
```

```kt
package com.usbarsenal.app.ui

import android.content.ClipData
import android.content.ClipboardManager
import androidx.activity.compose.BackHandler
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
import androidx.compose.runtime.rememberCoroutineScope
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.focus.focusRequester
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import com.usbarsenal.app.backend.logView
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/*
 * Log: the backend's log, every run from the app or a shell and tether's daemon, in time order,
 * kept across launches; the app's own faults go into the same file. The first frame draws the
 * last read; while the screen is open the file's tail is read once a second, in its own shell.
 * Clear empties the file, Copy logs copies the lines as the file has them.
 */
@Composable
fun LogScreen(back: () -> Unit) {
    BackHandler(onBack = back)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    // Opening the log is reading the fault, so the line that pointed here has done its job
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        Gadget.fault = null
        while (true) {
            Gadget.readLogTail()
            delay(1000)
        }
    }
    val lines = Gadget.log.mapNotNull(::logView)
    Screen(
        footer = {
            KeyRow {
                Key("Clear", Modifier.weight(1f)) { scope.launch { Gadget.clearLog() } }
                Key("Copy logs", Modifier.weight(1f).focusRequester(focusOn()), primary = true) {
                    context.getSystemService(ClipboardManager::class.java)
                        .setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("usb-arsenal log", Gadget.log.joinToString("\n")))
                }
            }
        },
    ) {
        Top { BackKey() }
        Title("Log")
        // A short window scrolls the screen to it, and it keeps a dozen lines
        Terminal(lines, Modifier.fill(min = 240.dp))
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.usbarsenal.app.ui

// The panels of the function screens, each named after its class in lcd.css

// What a LUN serves: [kind] is the mode the host sees (dvd, cdrom, disk), [access] ro or rw
data class DriveImage(val name: String, val size: String, val kind: String, val access: String)

/*
 * .drive: a 150dp box with an inverted 40dp face (the LED, the LUN, eject) over the disc (a pen
 * drive for a disk, padlocked when read-only), the file and `size · kind` with its access tag. Empty, the tray is out over the body:
 * a ghosted disc on the drive's ground, sliding in 3 steps of 2 frames. The body is the setup;
 * the LED is what runs: it blinks while the host is served, even with the pick ejected, is lit
 * for a pick not served yet, and hollow with neither.
 */
@Composable
fun Drive(lun: Int, image: DriveImage?, serving: Boolean, onEject: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val ink = LocalLcd.current.ink
    val ground = LocalLcd.current.ground
    val haptics = LocalHaptics.current
    val out = image == null
    val tray by animateDpAsState(if (out) 0.dp else (-110).dp, stepSpec(6, steps = 3), label = "tray")
    Box(modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(150.dp).border(Lcd.pixel, ink).padding(Lcd.pixel).clipToBounds()) {
        if (image != null) {
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(top = 40.dp).padding(horizontal = 14.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            ) {
                // The disc is a cd or dvd; a disk is a pen drive, locked when the host cannot write it
                val sprite = if (image.kind != "disk") Sprites.Storage else if (image.access == "rw") Sprites.Stick else Sprites.StickLocked
                SpriteIcon(sprite, 4.dp)
                Column(Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.lines)) {
                    Marquee(image.name, LcdType.data, Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        // A file outside the folder has no size to show here
                        Text(listOf(image.size, image.kind).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.joinToString(" · "), LcdType.data)
                        Tag(image.access)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // The tray hides above the body, under the face, until it slides out
        Box(
            Modifier
                .padding(top = 40.dp, start = 14.dp, end = 14.dp)
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .height(106.dp)
                .offset { IntOffset(0, tray.roundToPx()) }
                // No frame of its own: inside the drive's box a second one read as a stray rectangle
                .background(ground),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) { SpriteIcon(Sprites.Storage, 5.dp, Modifier.ghost(ground)) }
        Inverted {
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(40.dp).background(LocalLcd.current.ground).padding(start = 12.dp, end = 4.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            ) {
                LedDot(if (serving) Led.BUSY else if (out) Led.OFF else Led.ON)
                Text("lun$lun", LcdType.labelStrong)
                Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
                if (image != null) {
                    val interaction = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
                    Box(
                        Modifier
                            .size(44.dp, 40.dp)
                            .lcdClickable(interaction, outline = true, role = Role.Button) {
                                haptics.gestureEnd()
                                onEject()
                            }
                            .semantics { contentDescription = "Eject" },
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
                    ) { SpriteIcon(Sprites.Eject, 2.dp) }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// FILES and the folder the list reads

/*
 * A file in the list: its name, the LUN that holds it as a tag, its size. The picked file is
 * inverted, a focused one too. A file another LUN holds cannot be picked.
 */
@Composable
fun FileRow(name: String, size: String, lun: String?, selected: Boolean, onPick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val interaction = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
    val focused by interaction.collectIsFocusedAsState()
    val haptics = LocalHaptics.current
    val body = @Composable {
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 48.dp).background(LocalLcd.current.ground).padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.tight),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
            Marquee(name, LcdType.data, Modifier.weight(1f))
            if (lun != null) Tag(lun)
            Text(size, LcdType.data)
        }
    }
    Box(
        modifier
            .lcdClickable(interaction, outline = false, role = Role.RadioButton, enabled = lun == null) {
                haptics.tick()
                onPick()
            }
            .semantics { this.selected = selected },
    ) { Inverted(selected || focused, body) }
}

// .panel: a 2dp box over an inverted 40dp .face, as Identity's profile draws it. A lit card keeps
// the screen's [edge]: drawn in the card's own colours, it would vanish into the screen
@Composable
fun Panel(face: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit, edge: Color = LocalLcd.current.ink, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, body: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    Column(modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(LocalLcd.current.ground).border(Lcd.pixel, edge).padding(Lcd.pixel)) {
        Inverted {
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(40.dp).background(LocalLcd.current.ground).padding(horizontal = 12.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                content = face,
            )
        }
        body()
    }
}

// .node: one end of the tether chain, its name left and its value right; the phone is inverted
@Composable
fun Node(label: String, value: String? = null, inverted: Boolean = false) {
    val rule = LocalLcd.current.ink
    val body = @Composable {
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = Lcd.touch).background(LocalLcd.current.ground).border(Lcd.pixel, rule).padding(horizontal = 10.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
            Text(label, LcdType.labelStrong)
            if (value != null) Text(value, LcdType.data)
        }
    }
    Inverted(inverted, body)
}

/*
 * .wire: a dashed 6dp line joining two nodes, a packet stepping along it (4 steps a 1.2s
 * loop, against the line when [up]) and what carries it to the right. Reduced motion, or a link
 * that is not [moving], holds the packet at its first step.
 */
@Composable
fun Wire(label: String, up: Boolean = false, moving: Boolean = true) {
    val ink = LocalLcd.current.ink
    // A link that is down carries nothing: its packet rests
    val step = loop(1200, moving) { it * 4 / 1200 }
    Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(40.dp)) {
        Box(Modifier.padding(start = 44.dp).size(6.dp, 40.dp).dashes(ink))
        Box(
            Modifier
                .padding(start = 39.dp)
                .offset(y = (if (up) 32 - 8 * step else 8 * step).dp)
                .size(16.dp, 8.dp)
                .background(ink),
        )
        Text(label, LcdType.data, Modifier.padding(start = 66.dp, top = 10.dp))
    }
}

// .box: a value under its label, for counters such as Tx and Rx
@Composable
fun ValueBox(label: String, value: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) = Column(
    modifier.border(Lcd.pixel, LocalLcd.current.ink).padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.lines),
) {
    Text(label, LcdType.labelStrong)
    Text(value, LcdType.data)
}

/*
 * .inp: one line of VT323 in a 2dp box, with an ink cursor and the dashed focus cursor. The
 * placeholder states the default.
 */
@Composable
fun Input(
    value: String,
    onChange: (String) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    placeholder: String = "",
    keyboard: KeyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions.Default,
    // false locks it, its border dashed as a disabled key's: what it sets cannot change now, and
    // its value stays readable (a ghost's dither would knock the VT323 strokes out)
    enabled: Boolean = true,
    singleLine: Boolean = true,
) {
    val interaction = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
    val focused by interaction.collectIsFocusedAsState()
    val ink = LocalLcd.current.ink
    // The handles and the highlight are Compose's blue unless set. The highlight is a tint, not
    // solid ink: Compose draws it under the text, which keeps its colour and would vanish in ink
    CompositionLocalProvider(LocalTextSelectionColors provides TextSelectionColors(ink, ink.copy(alpha = 0.4f))) {
        BasicTextField(
            value,
            onChange,
            modifier
                .focusTick()
                .then(if (focused) Modifier.focusOutline(ink) else Modifier)
                .heightIn(min = Lcd.touch)
                .then(if (enabled) Modifier.border(Lcd.pixel, ink) else Modifier.dashedRect(ink, -Lcd.pixel)),
            enabled = enabled,
            textStyle = LcdType.data.copy(color = ink),
            singleLine = singleLine,
            keyboardOptions = keyboard,
            interactionSource = interaction,
            cursorBrush = SolidColor(ink),
            decorationBox = { field ->
                Box(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = if (singleLine) 0.dp else 8.dp), contentAlignment = if (singleLine) Alignment.CenterStart else Alignment.TopStart) {
                    if (value.isEmpty()) Text(placeholder, LcdType.data)
                    field()
                }
            },
        )
    }
}

// .field: a label over its input
@Composable
fun Field(label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, input: @Composable () -> Unit) = Column(
    modifier,
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
) {
    Text(label, LcdType.labelStrong)
    input()
}
```

```kt
package com.usbarsenal.app.ui

import android.os.Build
import androidx.activity.compose.LocalOnBackPressedDispatcherOwner
import androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedContent
import androidx.compose.animation.EnterExitState
import androidx.compose.animation.EnterTransition
import androidx.compose.animation.ExitTransition
```
