```kt
// The parts of lcd.css the screens share, each named after its class there

/*
 * .lcd.phone: the gutters, 22dp from the top, and the system bars kept clear. The body scrolls
 * when the window is too short for it (landscape, split screen, a large font), with the
 * scrollbar in the right gutter; the [footer], the screen's keys, stays pinned under it. A
 * [bottomBar] sits outside the gutters, flush to the screen edges, and keeps clear of the
 * navigation bar itself so its ground reaches under it. [scroll] off is for a screen that sizes
 * itself to the window (Keys + mouse's pad).
 */
@Composable
fun Screen(
    bottomBar: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
    footer: (@Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)? = null,
    scroll: Boolean = true,
    content: @Composable ScreenScope.() -> Unit,
) = Column(
    // The keyboard pushes the bar and the content up; the bar's own navigation-bar padding then gives way
    Modifier
        .fillMaxSize()
        .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing.only(WindowInsetsSides.Top))
        // A sheet pads for the keyboard itself; the screen behind its scrim stays put
        .then(if (SheetsOpen.count == 0) Modifier.imePadding() else Modifier),
) {
    Column(
        Modifier
            .weight(1f)
            .fillMaxWidth()
            // The sides here, not on the whole screen: the bottom bar's rule and ground reach the edges
            .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing.only(WindowInsetsSides.Horizontal))
            .then(if (bottomBar == null) Modifier.windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing.only(WindowInsetsSides.Bottom)) else Modifier)
            .padding(bottom = if (bottomBar == null) Lcd.gutter else Lcd.section)
            // Behind an open sheet nothing takes focus: a key pressed there would act unseen
            .focusProperties { onEnter = { if (SheetsOpen.count > 0) cancelFocusChange() } }
            // Nor does TalkBack reach it, whose double tap would act through the scrim
            .then(if (SheetsOpen.count > 0) Modifier.clearAndSetSemantics {} else Modifier)
            .focusGroup(),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.section),
    ) {
        ScreenBody(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(), scroll, content)
        footer?.let { Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = Lcd.gutter), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.section), content = it) }
    }
    bottomBar?.invoke()
}

/*
 * Back puts focus on what opened the screen. A screen leaves composition when the next one is
 * pushed, so focusRestorer has nothing left to restore: each opener carries an id instead, the
 * stack keeps the id that held focus at each push, and a pop asks for it again. After a touch
 * nothing holds focus, so nothing is asked for.
 */
object ReturnFocus {
    // The opener holding focus now
    var focused: String? = null
    // The opener the screen coming back focuses, once
    var returning by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
}

/*
 * Initial focus, the one rule for every screen: the primary key or first row asks once per
 * [key], from an effect, never the body. A shade or sheet open at that moment holds the ask
 * until it closes (Welcome under the no-root shade), and a screen Back returns to lets its
 * opener win instead.
 */
@Composable
fun focusOn(key: Any? = Unit): FocusRequester {
    val focus = remember { FocusRequester() }
    val asked = remember { arrayOfNulls<Any?>(1).also { it[0] = Asked } }
    val clear = SheetsOpen.count == 0
    LaunchedEffect(key, clear) {
        if (!clear || asked[0] == key) return@LaunchedEffect
        asked[0] = key
        if (ReturnFocus.returning == null) runCatching { focus.requestFocus() }
    }
    return focus
}

private object Asked

// ponytail: composed{} as lcdClickable is; a Modifier.Node if it ever shows in a trace
fun Modifier.opener(id: String): Modifier = composed {
    val focus = remember { FocusRequester() }
    // A shade on the screen going away holds focus out until its redraw ends, so wait for it
    LaunchedEffect(ReturnFocus.returning, SheetsOpen.count) {
        if (ReturnFocus.returning != id || SheetsOpen.count > 0) return@LaunchedEffect
        runCatching { focus.requestFocus() }
        ReturnFocus.returning = null
    }
    focusRequester(focus).onFocusChanged {
        if (it.hasFocus) ReturnFocus.focused = id else if (ReturnFocus.focused == id) ReturnFocus.focused = null
    }
}

// What a screen's body offers its parts
@LayoutScopeMarker
@Immutable
object ScreenScope {
    // The height the window leaves over the other parts, shared like a Column's weight, and never
    // under [min], so a list or a terminal stays usable when the window is short
    fun Modifier.fill(min: Dp = 0.dp, weight: Float = 1f) = then(Fill(min, weight))
}

private data class Fill(val min: Dp, val weight: Float) : ParentDataModifier {
    override fun Density.modifyParentData(parentData: Any?) = this@Fill
}

/*
 * A Column that knows the window: the parts at their own height, Lcd.section apart, and each
 * [ScreenScope.fill] part given what the window has left. When it all fits, the body is the
 * window's height, as a weighted Column would be; when not, it is as tall as its parts and scrolls.
 * The window's height comes in as the minimum: Screen's weight fixes the body's height, and
 * verticalScroll lifts only the maximum. Without [scroll], each part gets what the parts above
 * it left, as in a Column, so a part that sizes itself to its room (Keys + mouse) still can.
 */
@Composable
private fun ScreenBody(modifier: Modifier, scroll: Boolean, content: @Composable ScreenScope.() -> Unit) = Layout(
    content = { ScreenScope.content() },
    modifier = modifier
        .then(if (scroll) Modifier.lcdScroll(rememberScrollState(), inset = 0.dp) else Modifier)
        .padding(start = Lcd.gutter, end = Lcd.gutter, top = Lcd.topInset),
) { parts, c ->
        val room = c.minHeight
        val gap = Lcd.section.roundToPx()
        val fills = parts.map { it.parentData as? Fill }
        val placed = arrayOfNulls<Placeable>(parts.size)
        var used = gap * (parts.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)
        parts.forEachIndexed { i, part ->
            if (fills[i] != null) return@forEachIndexed
            val cap = if (c.hasBoundedHeight) (c.maxHeight - used).coerceAtLeast(0) else Constraints.Infinity
            placed[i] = part.measure(Constraints(maxWidth = c.maxWidth, maxHeight = cap)).also { used += it.height }
        }
        val weights = fills.sumOf { it?.weight?.toDouble() ?: 0.0 }
        val left = (room - used).coerceAtLeast(0)
        parts.forEachIndexed { i, part ->
            val f = fills[i] ?: return@forEachIndexed
            val h = maxOf(f.min.roundToPx(), (left * f.weight / weights).toInt())
            placed[i] = part.measure(Constraints(maxWidth = c.maxWidth, minHeight = h, maxHeight = h))
        }
        val tall = placed.sumOf { it!!.height } + gap * (parts.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)
        layout(c.maxWidth, maxOf(tall, room).coerceIn(c.minHeight, c.maxHeight)) {
            var y = 0
            placed.forEach {
                it!!.place(0, y)
                y += it.height + gap
            }
        }
}

/*
 * verticalScroll with the LCD's scrollbar: a 4dp ink thumb, as long as the share of the content
 * in view, there only while there is more to scroll. It sits 8dp to 4dp from the screen's edge,
 * clear of a row's or a rule's 10dp bleed; [inset] is how far the view's right edge is from the screen's.
 */
fun Modifier.lcdScroll(state: ScrollState, inset: Dp = Lcd.gutter) = composed {
    val ink = LocalLcd.current.ink
    drawWithContent {
        drawContent()
        val max = state.maxValue
        if (max in 1 until Int.MAX_VALUE) {
            thumb(ink, size.width + inset.toPx() - 8.dp.toPx(), size.height, size.height + max, state.value.toFloat() / max)
        }
    }.verticalScroll(
        state,
        // No stretch: it is smooth motion, and while it relaxes the scroll takes the next tap.
        // No scroll at all when everything fits, so the keys there have no gesture above them
        // to wait on, and press and click at once as the pinned keys do
        overscrollEffect = null,
        enabled = state.maxValue in 1 until Int.MAX_VALUE,
    )
}

// The thumb, its left edge at [left], for [view] of [total] pixels, [at] from 0 (top) to 1 (end), on the pixel grid
private fun DrawScope.thumb(ink: Color, left: Float, view: Float, total: Float, at: Float) {
    val px = Lcd.pixel.toPx()
    val len = maxOf(24.dp.toPx(), view * view / total)
    fun snap(v: Float) = (v / px).roundToInt() * px
    drawRect(ink, Offset(left, snap((view - len) * at)), Size(4.dp.toPx(), snap(len)))
}

// A row of keys sharing the width, as every screen's and sheet's keys sit
@Composable
fun KeyRow(content: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit) =
    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.tight), content = content)

/*
 * Silkscreen is a menu face and always uppercase; VT323 keeps its case. Only the first [typed]
 * characters show; the rest is laid out but clear, so text that types on never re-wraps.
 * [cursor] puts the working cursor inline after the typed part; [cursorSpace] keeps its place
 * without drawing it, so text that loses its cursor when it finishes typing keeps its wrap.
 */
@Composable
fun Text(
    text: String,
    style: TextStyle,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    cursor: Boolean = false,
    typed: Int = Int.MAX_VALUE,
    cursorSpace: Boolean = false,
    maxLines: Int = Int.MAX_VALUE,
) {
    val shown = if (style.fontFamily == LcdType.data.fontFamily) text else text.uppercase()
    val ink = LocalLcd.current.ink
    if (!cursor && !cursorSpace && typed >= shown.length) {
        BasicText(shown, modifier, style.copy(color = ink), maxLines = maxLines, overflow = TextOverflow.Clip)
        return
    }
    // 4dp gap plus the 10x16 block, as .blk's margin and size; on Jersey 10 it is .32em by .62em
    // on the baseline, as .big .blk
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    val big = style.fontFamily == LcdType.hero.fontFamily
    val block = with(density) {
        if (big) DpSize((style.fontSize * 0.32f).toDp(), (style.fontSize * 0.62f).toDp()) else BLK
    }
    val box = with(density) {
        Placeholder(
            (block.width + 4.dp).toSp(),
            block.height.toSp(),
            if (big) PlaceholderVerticalAlign.AboveBaseline else PlaceholderVerticalAlign.TextCenter,
        )
    }
    BasicText(
        buildAnnotatedString {
            append(shown.take(typed))
            if (cursor || cursorSpace) appendInlineContent("cursor")
            withStyle(SpanStyle(color = Color.Transparent)) { append(shown.drop(typed)) }
        },
        modifier,
        style.copy(color = ink),
        maxLines = maxLines,
        inlineContent = mapOf("cursor" to InlineTextContent(box) { if (cursor) Cursor(Modifier.padding(start = 4.dp), block) }),
    )
}

// Lists type on: element [i] is drawn once [shown] has passed it (DESIGN.md's rows typing on)
fun Modifier.drawnFrom(i: Int, shown: Int) = drawWithContent { if (i < shown) drawContent() }

/*
 * How many of [total] characters have typed: [perFrame] more every 40ms frame, and it carries
 * on when [total] grows. [instant] starts it fully typed (a result that was already there); a
 * new [key] starts it over. With reduced motion everything is typed.
 */
@Composable
fun rememberTyped(total: Int, perFrame: Int, instant: Boolean = false, key: Any? = Unit): Int {
    val reduced = LocalReducedMotion.current
    var n by remember(key) { mutableIntStateOf(if (instant) total else 0) }
    LaunchedEffect(key, total, reduced) {
        while (!reduced && n < total) {
            delay(FRAME_MS.toLong())
            n = minOf(n + perFrame, total)
        }
    }
    return if (reduced) total else n
}

/*
 * The beat between two lines. Text types quickly; it is the hold between lines that makes it
 * read like a machine working.
 */
const val LINE_PAUSE = 7

// What a person types (a command, a title) goes 3 characters every 2 frames, as steps of one frame
fun typeSteps(chars: Int) = (2 * chars + 2) / 3

fun typedIn(steps: Int) = steps * 3 / 2

private suspend fun PointerInputScope.swallowTouches() {
    awaitPointerEventScope {
        while (true) awaitPointerEvent(PointerEventPass.Initial).changes.forEach { it.consume() }
    }
}

/*
 * The LCD redraw: a new screen paints over the old one in [frames] bands, top to bottom, one
 * per 40ms frame; going [back] paints from the bottom up. The old screen stays alive underneath
 * until the last band, so nothing in it restarts. Reduced motion cuts. Screens use 4 bands, the
 * bottom bar 2.
 */
@Composable
fun <T> Redraw(
    target: T,
    back: Boolean,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    frames: Int = 4,
    content: @Composable (T) -> Unit,
) {
    val spec = stepSpec<Float>(frames)
    val ground = LocalLcd.current.ground
    AnimatedContent(
        target,
        // No size animation: a shorter state simply cuts in
        transitionSpec = { (EnterTransition.None togetherWith ExitTransition.KeepUntilTransitionsFinished) using null },
        label = "redraw",
    ) { screen ->
        val painted by transition.animateFloat({ spec }, label = "bands") { if (it == EnterExitState.PreEnter) 0f else 1f }
        val fromBottom = remember { back }
        // The screen going away stays drawn under the bands, but no touch reaches it
        val leaving = transition.targetState == EnterExitState.PostExit
        Box(
            modifier.then(if (leaving) Modifier.pointerInput(Unit) { swallowTouches() } else Modifier).drawWithContent {
                val h = size.height * painted
                clipRect(top = if (fromBottom) size.height - h else 0f, bottom = if (fromBottom) size.height else h) {
                    drawRect(ground)
                    this@drawWithContent.drawContent()
                }
            },
        ) { content(screen) }
    }
}

// .blk's size on menu and data text
private val BLK = DpSize(10.dp, 16.dp)

// .blk: on for half of every second; off keeps its place
@Composable
fun Cursor(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: DpSize = BLK) {
    val ink = LocalLcd.current.ink
    Box(modifier.size(size).then(if (cursorOn()) Modifier.background(ink) else Modifier))
}

/*
 * .key: the only object with depth. Pressing pushes it into its shadow for as long as it is
 * held (one frame, no easing). A disabled key loses its shadow and its border turns dashed, and
 * cannot take focus.
 */
@Composable
fun Key(
    label: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    primary: Boolean = false,
    enabled: Boolean = true,
    // VirtualKey, unless DESIGN.md's haptics table names another effect for what the key does
    haptic: Haptics.() -> Unit = { keyPress() },
    // Keys in a grid of many sit closer to their label; [icon] draws in place of it (arrows)
    padding: Dp = 14.dp,
    icon: Sprite? = null,
    minHeight: Dp = Lcd.touch,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
    val interaction = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
    val pressed by interaction.collectIsPressedAsState()
    val haptics = LocalHaptics.current
    val c = LocalLcd.current
    val filled = primary && enabled
    val depth = Lcd.keyDepth
    Box(
        modifier
            .offset { if (pressed && enabled) IntOffset(depth.roundToPx(), depth.roundToPx()) else IntOffset.Zero }
            .drawBehind {
                if (enabled && !pressed) drawRect(c.ink, topLeft = Offset(depth.toPx(), depth.toPx()), size = size)
            }
            .lcdClickable(interaction, outline = true, role = Role.Button, enabled = enabled) {
                haptics.haptic()
                onClick()
            }
            .background(if (filled) c.ink else c.ground)
            .then(if (enabled) Modifier.border(Lcd.pixel, c.ink) else Modifier.dashedRect(c.ink, -Lcd.pixel))
            .heightIn(min = minHeight)
            .padding(horizontal = padding)
            .semantics { if (icon != null) contentDescription = label },
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
        Inverted(filled) { if (icon != null) SpriteIcon(icon, 2.dp) else Text(label, LcdType.labelStrong, maxLines = 1) }
    }
}

// "< Back" in the top bar: the same as the system Back, so a screen's BackHandler decides
@Composable
fun BackKey(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true) {
    val dispatcher = LocalOnBackPressedDispatcherOwner.current?.onBackPressedDispatcher
    Key("< Back", modifier.semantics { contentDescription = "Back" }, enabled = enabled) { dispatcher?.onBackPressed() }
}

// .top: 44dp, even when empty, so titles line up from screen to screen
@Composable
fun Top(content: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit = {}) = Row(
    Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = Lcd.touch),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    content = content,
)

/*
 * Setup's steps in the top bar, in place of `< BACK`: one LED per step, lit up to [at]. A step
 * that joins while the row shows (Controller, once Root finds several) blinks twice, then holds.
 */
@Composable
fun Steps(at: Int, of: Int, joins: Boolean = false) {
    // The count this row first drew; with [joins], a dot past it has just joined
    val first = remember { if (joins) of else Int.MAX_VALUE }
    Row(
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clearAndSetSemantics { contentDescription = "Step $at of $of" },
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp, Alignment.CenterHorizontally),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
        for (i in 0 until of) if (i >= first) JoiningDot() else LedDot(if (i < at) Led.ON else Led.OFF)
    }
}

// Off, on, off, on, 3 frames each, then it stays; with reduced motion it is simply there
@Composable
private fun JoiningDot() {
    val reduced = LocalReducedMotion.current
    var beat by remember { mutableIntStateOf(if (reduced) 3 else 0) }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        while (beat < 3) {
            delay(3L * FRAME_MS)
            beat++
        }
    }
    if (beat % 2 == 0) Box(Modifier.size(8.dp)) else LedDot(Led.OFF)
}

// A title types on, at typing speed, each time its screen is drawn
@Composable
fun Title(text: String) {
    val n = typedIn(rememberTyped(typeSteps(text.length), 1))
    Text(text, LcdType.title, cursor = n < text.length, typed = n, cursorSpace = true)
}

// .rule: 2dp of ink across the 10dp bleed, the line between Home's rows; it parts a screen's sections
@Composable
fun Rule(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) = Box(modifier.bleed(10.dp).fillMaxWidth().height(Lcd.pixel).background(LocalLcd.current.ink))

// .tag: a short inverted word beside data
@Composable
fun Tag(text: String) = Inverted {
    Text(text, LcdType.data, Modifier.background(LocalLcd.current.ground).padding(horizontal = 6.dp))
}

// .warn: a consequence, in the inverted voice
@Composable
fun Warn(text: String) = Inverted {
    Text(text, LcdType.data, Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(LocalLcd.current.ground).padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 8.dp))
}

enum class Led { OFF, ON, BUSY }

/*
 * .led: lit when the thing works, hollow when there is nothing, and while it works it blinks
 * twice in 1.2s, as lcd.css's led keyframes: off at 30-40% and 55-60%.
 */
@Composable
fun LedDot(led: Led) {
    val hidden = led == Led.BUSY && loop(1200) { it in 360 until 480 || it in 660 until 720 }
    val ink = LocalLcd.current.ink
    val dot = Modifier.size(8.dp)
    when {
        hidden -> Box(dot)
        led == Led.OFF -> Box(dot.border(Lcd.pixel, ink))
        else -> Box(dot.background(ink))
    }
}

// The phone's codename, as adb shell's prompt shows it; no root needed to read it
val host = listOf(Build.DEVICE, Build.PRODUCT).firstOrNull { !it.isNullOrBlank() && it != "unknown" } ?: "localhost"

// One Enter's worth of a shell: the prompt, what is typed after it, and what that printed. Output
// that came as one piece ([block], check's report) types straight through, its beat only at the end
class ShellLine(val prompt: String, val typed: String = "", val out: List<String> = emptyList(), val block: Boolean = false)

/*
 * A shell session plays on the 40ms frame clock, one step a frame:
 * - a prompt appears at once, the cursor holds on it for a beat, then the command types at
 *   typing speed;
 * - Enter: the output types, 4 characters a frame with a beat between its lines, and the next
 *   prompt comes the moment the output ends;
 * - a session ends on a prompt with nothing typed, whose beat is the last step.
 */
private fun outSteps(line: String) = (line.length + 3) / 4

private fun ShellLine.steps() =
    LINE_PAUSE + typeSteps(typed.length) + out.sumOf(::outSteps) + if (block) 0 else LINE_PAUSE * (out.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)

fun List<ShellLine>.steps() = sumOf { it.steps() }

// The step at which line [i]'s command has typed: Enter, when its real work starts
fun List<ShellLine>.enterAt(i: Int) = take(i).steps() + LINE_PAUSE + typeSteps(this[i].typed.length)

// The terminal lines a session shows after [step] steps
fun List<ShellLine>.shownAt(step: Int): List<String> {
    val shown = mutableListOf<String>()
    var left = step
    for (line in this) {
        shown += line.prompt + line.typed.take(typedIn(left - LINE_PAUSE).coerceIn(0, line.typed.length))
        left -= LINE_PAUSE + typeSteps(line.typed.length)
        if (left < 0) return shown
        line.out.forEachIndexed { k, out ->
            if (k > 0 && !line.block) {
                left -= LINE_PAUSE
                if (left < 0) return shown
            }
            // A line shows once its first characters have typed, never as an empty bar
            if (left <= 0) return shown
            shown += out.take(4 * left)
            left -= outSteps(out)
            if (left < 0) return shown
        }
    }
    return shown
}

/*
 * A shell window: a light strip (the LED, what runs, and the phone's codename) over the
 * inverted terminal, inside one 2dp box. Root and Backend both use it.
 */
@Composable
fun Shell(label: String, led: Led, lines: List<String>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val ink = LocalLcd.current.ink
    val haptics = LocalHaptics.current
    // A typewriter: a tick on each frame that lands characters, none in the beat between lines.
    // A session that opens already typed starts from its count, so it stays quiet
    val chars = lines.sumOf { it.length }
    var last by remember { mutableIntStateOf(chars) }
    LaunchedEffect(chars) {
        if (chars > last) haptics.frequentTick()
        last = chars
    }
    Column(modifier.fillMaxWidth().border(Lcd.pixel, ink).padding(Lcd.pixel)) {
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(32.dp).padding(horizontal = 10.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                LedDot(led)
                Text(label, LcdType.labelStrong)
            }
            Text(host, LcdType.data)
        }
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(Lcd.pixel).background(ink))
        Terminal(lines, Modifier.weight(1f))
    }
}

// .kv: a label and its value. Facts nobody taps (.kv.fact) are 32dp, so long lists fit
@Composable
fun Kv(label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, fact: Boolean = false, value: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit) = Row(
    modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = if (fact) 32.dp else Lcd.touch),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.tight),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
) {
    Text(label, LcdType.label)
    Row(Modifier.weight(1f), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.End, verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, content = value)
}

// .grp: a bold heading over a group of facts
@Composable
fun Group(label: String) = Text(label, LcdType.labelStrong, Modifier.padding(top = 4.dp))

// .note: what a missing fact means, under its row
@Composable
fun Note(text: String) = Text(text, LcdType.data, Modifier.padding(bottom = 8.dp))

// The installer's "[+] ", "[-] " and "[!] "
private val GLYPH = Regex("^\\[.] ")

/*
 * .term: live output on a whole inverted panel, its newest line backlit with the cursor. It
 * fills from the top down like a terminal and, once full, keeps the newest line in view. A line
 * that starts with a glyph such as "[+]" puts it in the 28dp column, so wrapped text lines up
 * after it; any other line (a prompt, stderr) uses the whole width. Only the lines on screen
 * are composed, so a long log costs what a short one does.
 */
// [live] false is a document on the panel (a licence): no backlit line, no cursor. It is short and
// composed whole, so its scrollbar measures pixels; lines of a log are one row each, so counting
// them is exact, but a document's paragraphs differ in height and a count made its thumb jump
@Composable
fun Terminal(lines: List<String>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, live: Boolean = true) {
    val cursor = LocalLcd.current.ink
    // A log opens on its newest line; scrolling there after the first frame showed the top first
    val list = rememberLazyListState(if (live) lines.lastIndex.coerceAtLeast(0) else 0)
    val page = rememberScrollState()
    Inverted {
        val state = if (live) list else page
        // Nothing to scroll is no Tab stop
        val panel = modifier.keyScroll(state, cursor, enabled = state.canScrollForward || state.canScrollBackward)
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .background(LocalLcd.current.ground)
        if (live) TerminalList(lines, list, cursor, panel)
        // In the terminal's 10dp padding, 4dp from its edge, as the log's
        else Column(panel.lcdScroll(page, inset = 0.dp).padding(10.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
            for (line in lines) TerminalLine(line, newest = false, cursor)
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun TerminalList(lines: List<String>, list: LazyListState, cursor: Color, modifier: Modifier) {
    // Each new line is brought into view before the frame is measured, so a log filling from
    // empty never draws its top lines first (a scroll from an effect lands a frame late)
    val seen = remember { object { var size = -1; var last: String? = null } }
    SideEffect {
        if (lines.isNotEmpty() && (lines.size != seen.size || lines.last() != seen.last)) {
            seen.size = lines.size
            seen.last = lines.last()
            list.requestScrollToItem(lines.lastIndex)
        }
    }
    val ink = LocalLcd.current.ink
    LazyColumn(
        modifier
            // The scrollbar, by lines: what share of them is in view, and how far down the first is
            .drawWithContent {
                drawContent()
                val info = list.layoutInfo
                val total = info.totalItemsCount
                val seen = info.visibleItemsInfo.size
                if (seen in 1 until total) {
                    val first = list.firstVisibleItemIndex.toFloat()
                    // In the terminal's 10dp padding, 4dp from its edge, as every scrollbar
                    thumb(ink, size.width - 8.dp.toPx(), size.height, size.height * total / seen, first / (total - seen).coerceAtLeast(1))
                }
            }
            .padding(10.dp),
        state = list,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
    ) {
        itemsIndexed(lines) { i, line -> TerminalLine(line, i == lines.lastIndex, cursor) }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun TerminalLine(line: String, newest: Boolean, cursor: Color) {
    val glyph = GLYPH.find(line)?.value
    Inverted(newest) {
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(LocalLcd.current.ground).padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 3.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        ) {
            if (glyph != null) Text(glyph.trim(), LcdType.data, Modifier.width(28.dp))
            Text(line.removePrefix(glyph.orEmpty()), LcdType.data, cursor = newest)
        }
    }
}
```

`Android/app/src/main/java/com/usbarsenal/app/ui/Reports.kt`:

```kt
package com.usbarsenal.app.ui

/*
 * The HID reports, as hid.c's report descriptors lay them out: a keyboard report is 8 bytes
 * (modifiers, a reserved 0, six keycodes from usage page 7), a mouse report 4 (buttons, then X,
 * Y and the wheel, each a signed byte).
 */

const val MOUSE_LEFT = 0x01
const val MOUSE_RIGHT = 0x02
const val MOUSE_MIDDLE = 0x04

const val MOD_CTRL = 0x01
const val MOD_SHIFT = 0x02
const val MOD_ALT = 0x04
const val MOD_SUPER = 0x08

private fun signed(v: Int) = v.coerceIn(-127, 127).toByte()

fun mouseReport(buttons: Int, dx: Int = 0, dy: Int = 0, wheel: Int = 0) =
    byteArrayOf(buttons.toByte(), signed(dx), signed(dy), signed(wheel))

fun keyReport(mods: Int = 0, code: Int = 0) = byteArrayOf(mods.toByte(), 0, code.toByte(), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)

// The keys the Keys tab names, by their usage codes
val NAMED_KEYS: Map<String, Int> = mapOf(
    "ESC" to 0x29, "TAB" to 0x2B, "BKSP" to 0x2A, "DEL" to 0x4C, "ENTER" to 0x28,
    "INS" to 0x49, "HOME" to 0x4A, "END" to 0x4D, "PGUP" to 0x4B, "PGDN" to 0x4E, "PRTSC" to 0x46,
    "RIGHT" to 0x4F, "LEFT" to 0x50, "DOWN" to 0x51, "UP" to 0x52,
) + (1..12).associate { "F$it" to 0x39 + it }

val MODIFIERS: Map<String, Int> = mapOf("SHIFT" to MOD_SHIFT, "CTRL" to MOD_CTRL, "ALT" to MOD_ALT, "SUPER" to MOD_SUPER)

// US layout: the unshifted and shifted character on each key past the letters and digits
private const val SYMBOLS = "-_=+[{]}\\|;:'\"`~,<.>/?"
private val SYMBOL_CODES = intArrayOf(0x2D, 0x2E, 0x2F, 0x30, 0x31, 0x33, 0x34, 0x35, 0x36, 0x37, 0x38)
private const val SHIFTED_DIGITS = ")!@#$%^&*("

// The modifiers and usage code that type [c] on a US layout; null for a character it cannot
fun keyFor(c: Char): Pair<Int, Int>? = when (c) {
    in 'a'..'z' -> 0 to 0x04 + (c - 'a')
    in 'A'..'Z' -> MOD_SHIFT to 0x04 + (c - 'A')
    '0' -> 0 to 0x27
    in '1'..'9' -> 0 to 0x1E + (c - '1')
    ' ' -> 0 to 0x2C
    '\n' -> 0 to 0x28
    '\t' -> 0 to 0x2B
    else -> {
        val shifted = SHIFTED_DIGITS.indexOf(c)
        val symbol = SYMBOLS.indexOf(c)
        when {
            shifted >= 0 -> MOD_SHIFT to if (shifted == 0) 0x27 else 0x1E + shifted - 1
            symbol >= 0 -> (if (symbol % 2 == 1) MOD_SHIFT else 0) to SYMBOL_CODES[symbol / 2]
            else -> null
        }
    }
}

// The bInterval period for [n]: at high and super speed an exponent, 2^(n-1) x 125us, as hid.c
// gives it; at full speed (a USB 1.1 host) n whole 1 ms frames
fun periodText(n: Int, fullSpeed: Boolean = false): String {
    if (fullSpeed) return "$n ms"
    val us = (1L shl (n - 1)) * 125
    // From 1 ms up every period is whole milliseconds; past a second, 1.024 s to 4.096 s
    return when {
        us < 1000 -> "$us us"
        us < 1_000_000 -> "${us / 1000} ms"
        else -> "%.3f s".format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, us / 1e6)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.usbarsenal.app.ui

import com.usbarsenal.app.backend.Controller

private const val SOURCE = "github.com/ravindu644/USB-Arsenal"

// A section after the first: a rule, then its heading
@Composable
private fun Section(label: String) {
    Rule(Modifier.padding(vertical = 10.dp))
    Group(label)
}

/*
 * Settings, in sections parted by rules: Identity (the profile in force, opening Identity),
 * Backend (the PATH link, read at the next boot, Requirements, which runs Check again after a
 * kernel update, and Reinstall), App (motion, haptics), Credits (the fonts) and About. The PATH
 * link is Droidspaces' switch, done the same way.
 */
@Composable
fun SettingsScreen(back: () -> Unit, openIdentity: () -> Unit, openFonts: () -> Unit, openCheck: () -> Unit, fix: (Backend) -> Unit) {
    BackHandler(onBack = back)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val switches = LocalSwitches.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val backend = Gadget.backend
    var linked by remember { mutableStateOf(Cache.pathLinked) }
    // Held while the link is written, so its Dip shows the flip until the write answers
    var linking by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    // The switch away from what it was first read as in this process, the closest the app knows
    // to what the boot read: then it takes effect at the next boot, which is worth saying
    // ponytail: a change made in an earlier run since the boot reads as the boot's value
    val changed = BootLink.linked != null && linked != BootLink.linked
    // A switch whose write failed shakes, and stderr's last line sits under it
    var fault by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val shake = rememberShake()
    // The controllers as read at launch, so the USB section is there from the first frame
    val udcs = Controller.udcs.orEmpty()
    var choosingUdc by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var choosingTheme by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        // Reads only, none behind the change lane; each replaces its cached value when it answers
        backendState(context).let { Gadget.backend = it; Cache.backend = it }
        pathLinked()?.let { linked = it; Cache.pathLinked = it; if (BootLink.linked == null) BootLink.linked = it }
        readProfile().takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { Gadget.profile = it; Cache.profile = it }
    }
    fun write(r: RootResult, done: () -> Unit) {
        fault = null
        if (r.ok) {
            done()
        } else {
            fault = r.why
            shake.fire()
        }
    }
    val installed = backend?.state == BackendState.READY || backend?.state == BackendState.UPDATE_AVAILABLE
    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        Screen {
            Top { BackKey() }
            Title("Settings")
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
                Group("Identity")
                LinkRow("Profile", profileName(Gadget.profile), openIdentity, Modifier.opener("settings/identity").focusRequester(focusOn()))

                // Every command names it. The backend keeps the controller it holds while bound,
                // so a change waits until nothing is
                if (udcs.size > 1) {
                    Section("USB")
                    val bound = Gadget.status?.bound == true
                    LinkRow("Controller", Controller.picked ?: "none", if (bound) null else ({ choosingUdc = true }), Modifier.opener("settings/controller"))
                    if (bound) Note("stop all to change it")
                }

                Section("Backend")
                // The link lives in the module, so it is held until read, and without a backend
                // installed: it would name a binary not there
                Kv("System path", Modifier.shake(shake)) {
                    Dip(linked == true, { on -> linking = true; scope.launch { write(setPathLinked(on)) { linked = on }; linking = false } }, "System path", held = linking || linked == null || !installed)
                }
                // One line kept for its fault or its warning, so the sections below never move
                Box(Modifier.heightIn(min = Lcd.touch)) {
                    val f = fault
                    when {
                        f != null -> Fault(f, onLog = null)
                        changed -> Warn("applies from the next boot")
                    }
                }
                Key("Requirements", Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = 6.dp).opener("settings/check"), onClick = openCheck)
                Key("Reinstall", Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = 10.dp, bottom = 10.dp).opener("settings/reinstall"), enabled = backend != null) {
                    backend?.let(fix)
                }

                Section("App")
                Kv("Motion") { Dip(switches.motion, { switches.motion = it }, "Motion") }
                Kv("Haptics") { Dip(switches.haptics, { switches.haptics = it }, "Haptics") }
                LinkRow("Theme", switches.theme.label, { choosingTheme = true }, Modifier.opener("settings/theme"))

                Section("Credits")
                LinkRow("Fonts", "SIL OFL 1.1", openFonts, Modifier.opener("settings/fonts"))

                Section("About")
                Kv("App", fact = true) { Text(BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME, LcdType.data) }
                LinkRow("Source", SOURCE, onClick = {
                    context.startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, "https://$SOURCE".toUri()).addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK))
                })
            }
        }
        ChoiceSheet(
            choosingUdc, "Controller", udcs.map { it.name }, Controller.picked.orEmpty(), "No controllers",
            onPick = { name ->
                choosingUdc = false
                scope.launch {
                    val r = Controller.set(name)
                    if (!r.ok) {
                        fault = r.why
                        shake.fire()
                        return@launch
                    }
                    // What the kernel can do is asked again, of this controller
                    Gadget.readCheckOnce()
                }
            },
            onDismiss = { choosingUdc = false },
            detail = { name -> udcs.firstOrNull { it.name == name }?.state.orEmpty() },
        )
        // The pick cuts the whole screen over in one frame, as an LCD would
        ChoiceSheet(
            choosingTheme, "Theme", Theme.entries.map { it.label }, switches.theme.label, "",
            onPick = { label ->
                choosingTheme = false
                switches.theme = Theme.entries.first { it.label == label }
            },
            onDismiss = { choosingTheme = false },
            detail = { label -> if (Theme.entries.first { it.label == label }.lit) "lit" else "negative" },
        )
    }
}

// The link as first read in this process, for "applies from the next boot"
private object BootLink {
    var linked: Boolean? = null
}

// The three faces' copyright lines, then the licence they share
private fun licence(context: Context): List<String> {
    val files = context.assets.list("licenses").orEmpty().sorted()
    val texts = files.map { f -> context.assets.open("licenses/$f").bufferedReader().readLines() }
    val body = texts.firstOrNull().orEmpty().let { lines -> lines.drop(lines.indexOfFirst { it.contains("SIL OPEN FONT LICENSE") }.coerceAtLeast(0)) }
    // The files wrap at 75 columns; the panel wraps to its own width, so each paragraph is one line
    val paragraphs = body.joinToString("\n").split(Regex("\n\\s*\n")).map { it.lines().joinToString(" ") { l -> l.trim() } }
    return texts.mapNotNull { it.firstOrNull() } + paragraphs
}

// Fonts: each face and its licence, then the licence itself on the panel, read as a document
@Composable
fun FontsScreen(back: () -> Unit) {
    BackHandler(onBack = back)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    // Off the main thread: three asset files are a read, not a frame's work
    val text by produceState(emptyList<String>()) { value = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { licence(context) } }
    Screen {
        Top { BackKey(Modifier.focusRequester(focusOn())) }
        Title("Fonts")
        Column {
            for (face in listOf("Jersey 10", "Silkscreen", "VT323")) Kv(face, fact = true) { Text("OFL 1.1", LcdType.data) }
        }
        Terminal(text, Modifier.fill(min = 240.dp), live = false)
    }
}
```

```kt
import com.usbarsenal.app.backend.rootInfo
import com.usbarsenal.app.backend.stageBinary
import com.usbarsenal.app.lcd.Lcd
import com.usbarsenal.app.lcd.LcdType
import com.usbarsenal.app.lcd.LocalHaptics
import com.usbarsenal.app.lcd.Pin
import com.usbarsenal.app.lcd.Sprite
import com.usbarsenal.app.lcd.SpriteIcon
import com.usbarsenal.app.lcd.Sprites
import java.io.File
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

// Status is re-read this often while the app is started (and after every command)
const val POLL_MS = 2_000L

// Every screen; App keeps them as a back stack
private enum class Step { WELCOME, ROOT, CONTROLLER, CHECK, INSTALL, HOME, LOG, SETTINGS, FONTS, STORAGE, TETHER, HID, KEYS, QUACKY, IDENTITY }

// TYPING: Install was pressed and the command is typing; the installer starts when it has
private enum class Phase { BEFORE, TYPING, RUNNING, DONE, FAILED }

/*
 * What setup has found, kept for as long as the process lives (until the app is cleared from
 * recents), so Back never asks root or the kernel again. Only Retry and Recheck do.
 */
private object Setup {
    var root by mutableStateOf<Result<String>?>(null)
    var check by mutableStateOf<Result<Capabilities>?>(null)
    // check's own report, as its shell shows it
    var report by mutableStateOf<List<String>>(emptyList())
    var staged: File? = null


    // An install that ended is kept (Cache.install), so a restore onto Install shows it, never runs it again
    val log = mutableStateListOf<String>().also { it.addAll(Cache.install?.second.orEmpty()) }
    var phase by mutableStateOf(Cache.install?.first?.let { n -> Phase.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == n } } ?: Phase.BEFORE)
    // A Retry starts the shell session over; the first Install types on in the same one
    var retries by mutableIntStateOf(0)

    // The install belongs to no screen: leaving one, or the activity going, never stops it
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Main)

    // A new visit to Install after one that finished starts from the prompt again
    fun fresh() {
        if (phase == Phase.DONE || phase == Phase.FAILED) {
            log.clear()
            phase = Phase.BEFORE
            Cache.install = null
        }
    }

    // Install pressed: the command starts typing
    fun enter() {
        log.clear()
        phase = Phase.TYPING
        Cache.install = null
    }

    fun install(context: Context) {
        phase = Phase.RUNNING
        scope.launch {
            val ok = installBackend(context.applicationContext) { log += it }
            // Home draws the installed state at once, not the one from before
            if (ok) Gadget.launchReads(context.applicationContext)
            phase = if (ok) Phase.DONE else Phase.FAILED
            Cache.install = phase.name to log.toList()
        }
    }
}

/*
 * First launch walks Welcome, Root, Check and Install, then Home; once an install has
 * finished, launches open Home. Screens stack: Back pops one, painting bottom up, and Back on
 * the last one leaves the app. Every screen change is the LCD redraw.
 */
@Composable
fun App() {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("setup", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    var stack by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(listOf(if (prefs.getBoolean("done", false)) Step.HOME else Step.WELCOME)) }
    var back by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    // The installed version when Install was opened to update it
    var update by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
    // A denial is kept for the process, but "reopen the app" means a new activity asks again
    remember { if (Setup.root?.isFailure == true) Setup.root = null }
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var showing by remember { mutableStateOf<Job?>(null) }
    // openers[i] held focus on stack[i] when stack[i + 1] was pushed (ReturnFocus)
    var openers by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(listOf<String?>()) }
    fun show(next: List<Step>, goingBack: Boolean) {
        // One at a time: a second tap in the gap below would stack a screen twice
        if (showing?.isActive == true) return
        val from = ReturnFocus.focused
        ReturnFocus.returning = if (next.size == stack.size - 1) openers.getOrNull(next.size - 1) else null
        // Padded to the stack, which a recreation can bring back longer than this
        val held = (openers + List(stack.size) { null }).take(stack.size - 1)
        openers = if (next.size > stack.size) held + from else held.take(next.size - 1)
        // Focus leaves with the old screen, so a key press during the redraw cannot reach it
        focusManager.clearFocus()
        // The key that asked has just lifted: draw that frame first. Composing the next screen
        // takes a frame of 50 to 100ms, and in the same frame it held the key down that long
        showing = scope.launch {
            withFrameNanos {}
            withFrameNanos {}
            back = goingBack
            stack = next
        }
    }
    fun push(s: Step) = show(stack + s, false)
    fun pop() = show(stack.dropLast(1), true)
    val home = {
        prefs.edit { putBoolean("done", true) }
        show(listOf(Step.HOME), false)
    }
    val setup = stack.first() != Step.HOME
    // What a backend that needs something leads to: Install, as an update over an installed one.
    // No root is no key, but the shade over every screen
    val fix = { b: Backend ->
        update = b.installed
        Setup.fresh()
        push(Step.INSTALL)
    }
    // Once a launch: the backend, the kernel, the profile, the controllers. A set-up app on a
    // phone with several and no pick (set up before the step existed) is asked for one first
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        if (stack.first() == Step.HOME) {
            Gadget.launchReads(context)
            if (Controller.refresh() && stack.last() != Step.CONTROLLER) push(Step.CONTROLLER)
        } else if (stack.size > 2) {
            // Setup brought back past Root (the process was killed) counts its steps again
            Controller.refresh()
        }
    }
    // The one status loop: every screen reads Gadget.status; the read lane never waits on a command.
    // Not while setup runs (no backend to ask yet): read through state, since the loop outlives
    // the composition that started it
    val owner = LocalLifecycleOwner.current
    val inSetup by rememberUpdatedState(setup)
    LaunchedEffect(owner) {
        owner.lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
            while (true) {
                if (!inSetup && Gadget.backend?.state != BackendState.NO_ROOT) Gadget.refresh()
                delay(POLL_MS)
            }
        }
    }
    // A real bind (the port left Android) thuds wherever it was started; Home's Pin plugs in on it
    val haptics = LocalHaptics.current
    var thudded by remember { mutableIntStateOf(Gadget.binds) }
    LaunchedEffect(Gadget.binds) {
        if (Gadget.binds > thudded) haptics.bindPlug()
        thudded = Gadget.binds
    }
    Redraw(stack.last(), back, Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        when (it) {
            Step.WELCOME -> Welcome { push(Step.ROOT) }
            Step.ROOT -> RootScreen(back = ::pop) {
                // More than one controller (Root read them): the user picks theirs before Check runs
                // with it, a kept pick already picked. With one, no pick and no step
                push(if (several()) Step.CONTROLLER else Step.CHECK)
            }
            // In setup it leads on to Check; asked for at a launch, it goes back to Home
            Step.CONTROLLER -> ControllerScreen(setup, back = ::pop) { if (setup) push(Step.CHECK) else pop() }
            Step.CHECK -> CheckScreen(setup, back = ::pop) {
                Setup.fresh()
                push(Step.INSTALL)
            }
            Step.INSTALL -> InstallScreen(setup, update = update, back = ::pop, home = home)
            Step.HOME -> HomeScreen(
                open = { fn ->
                    push(
                        when (fn) {
                            Fn.STORAGE -> Step.STORAGE
                            Fn.TETHER -> Step.TETHER
                            Fn.HID -> Step.HID
                        },
                    )
                },
                openLog = { push(Step.LOG) },
                openSettings = { push(Step.SETTINGS) },
                fix = fix,
            )
            Step.LOG -> LogScreen(back = ::pop)
            Step.SETTINGS -> SettingsScreen(
                back = ::pop,
                openIdentity = { push(Step.IDENTITY) },
                openFonts = { push(Step.FONTS) },
                // A fresh check each time: the kernel may have been updated since the last
                openCheck = { Setup.check = null; push(Step.CHECK) },
                fix = fix,
            )
            Step.FONTS -> FontsScreen(back = ::pop)
            Step.IDENTITY -> IdentityScreen(back = ::pop, openLog = { push(Step.LOG) })
            Step.STORAGE -> StorageScreen(back = ::pop, openLog = { push(Step.LOG) })
            Step.TETHER -> TetherScreen(back = ::pop, openLog = { push(Step.LOG) })
            Step.HID -> HidScreen(back = ::pop, openKeys = { push(Step.KEYS) }, openQuacky = { push(Step.QUACKY) })
            Step.KEYS -> KbdMouseScreen(back = ::pop)
            Step.QUACKY -> QuackyScreen(back = ::pop)
        }
    }
    // A set-up app that finds no root at launch: nothing works, on any screen, until it is granted
    if (!setup && Gadget.backend?.state == BackendState.NO_ROOT) NoRoot()
}

// Setup is Root, Check and Backend, and Controller after Root on a phone with several
private fun several() = (Controller.udcs?.size ?: 0) > 1

private fun setupSteps() = if (several()) 4 else 3

// Welcome's parts come on one per frame, top to bottom, as DESIGN.md's rows typing on
@Composable
private fun Welcome(next: () -> Unit) {
    val shown = rememberTyped(5, 1)
    fun Modifier.from(i: Int) = drawnFrom(i, shown)
    Screen(footer = { Key("Get started", Modifier.fillMaxWidth().from(4).focusRequester(focusOn(Unit)), primary = true, onClick = next) }) {
        Top {
            Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
            Text("v${BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME}", LcdType.data, Modifier.from(0))
        }
        Pin(8.dp, Modifier.from(1))
        Text("USB\nArsenal", LcdType.hero, Modifier.from(2))
        Column(Modifier.from(3)) {
            Feature(Sprites.Storage, "boot an iso or share a disk")
            Feature(Sprites.Tether, "network over the usb cable")
            Feature(Sprites.Hid, "keyboard and mouse on the host")
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun Feature(sprite: Sprite, text: String) = Row(
    Modifier.heightIn(min = Lcd.touch),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.tight),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
) {
    Box(Modifier.size(32.dp), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) { SpriteIcon(sprite, 2.dp) }
    Text(text, LcdType.data)
}

private const val ASKING = "# checking root access"

/*
 * `id -u; su -v` in a root shell, played as that shell: a comment saying what is happening,
 * `su`, and once it answers, the root prompt's commands and what they printed. su is asked the
 * moment `su` has typed; Back waits for its answer, which the 15s timeout bounds.
 */
@Composable
private fun RootScreen(back: () -> Unit, next: () -> Unit) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val haptics = LocalHaptics.current
    // A result that was already there shows at once; one that arrives now types
    val had = remember { Setup.root != null }
    val result = Setup.root
    val session = buildList {
        add(ShellLine("$ ", ASKING))
        add(ShellLine("$ ", "su", result?.exceptionOrNull()?.let { listOf(it.message.orEmpty()) }.orEmpty()))
        result?.onSuccess {
            add(ShellLine("# ", "# root access granted !"))
            add(ShellLine("# ", "id -u", listOf("0")))
            add(ShellLine("# ", "su -v", listOf(it)))
            add(ShellLine("# "))
        }
    }
    val total = session.steps()
    val step = rememberTyped(total, 1, instant = had)
    val stepNow by rememberUpdatedState(step)
    val enter = session.enterAt(1)
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        if (Setup.root != null) return@LaunchedEffect
        snapshotFlow { stepNow }.first { it >= enter }
        val r = rootInfo()
        // Controller's step joins the dots here, so it is there before Next lights
        if (r.isSuccess) Controller.refresh()
        Setup.root = r
    }
    val done = result != null && step >= total
    // Reject once the denial is on screen, not when su answers ahead of the typing
    LaunchedEffect(done) { if (done && result.isFailure && !had) haptics.reject() }
    // Back leaves until su is asked, as Check's does; then su's answer comes first
    BackHandler { if (done || stepNow < enter) back() }
    val focus = focusOn(done)
    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        Screen(
            footer = {
                // Next is there from the start, dashed until su has said yes, so nothing pops in
                if (done && result.isSuccess) {
                    Key("Next", Modifier.fillMaxWidth().focusRequester(focus), primary = true, onClick = next)
                } else {
                    Key("Next", Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), primary = true, enabled = false) {}
                }
            },
        ) {
            Top { Steps(1, setupSteps(), joins = true) }
            Title("Root")
            Shell("su", if (!done) Led.BUSY else if (result.isSuccess) Led.ON else Led.OFF, session.shownAt(step), Modifier.fill(min = 200.dp))
        }
        // Root managers today only take a grant at the app's next start, so there is no retry
        if (done && result.isFailure) NoRoot(light = true)
    }
}

// No root: the page shaded, Pin in tears, and what to do, which happens outside the app. On
// Root it sits over the terminal, so the box is [light]
@Composable
private fun NoRoot(light: Boolean = false) = Shade("Grant root, then\nreopen the app", light) { SpriteIcon(Sprites.PinSad, 3.dp) }

// What Check types; the app runs the binary it staged (backend/readCheckReport)
private const val CHECK = "usb-arsenal check"

/*
 * The bundled binary checks the kernel before anything is installed, played as a root shell
 * like Backend's: a comment says what is happening, the command types, check runs the moment
 * it has typed, and its own report is the output. A result that was already there (Back from
 * Backend) shows at once; Recheck starts the session over. Opened from Settings ([setup] false)
 * it runs afresh each time, so its one key is Done, back to Settings.
 */
@Composable
private fun CheckScreen(setup: Boolean, back: () -> Unit, next: () -> Unit) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val haptics = LocalHaptics.current
    var run by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    val had = remember { Setup.check != null }
    val result = Setup.check
    val session = buildList {
        add(ShellLine("# ", "# checking this kernel for usb arsenal"))
        if (result == null) {
            add(ShellLine("# ", CHECK))
        } else {
            add(ShellLine("# ", CHECK, Setup.report, block = true))
            add(ShellLine("# "))
        }
    }
    val total = session.steps()
    val step = rememberTyped(total, 1, instant = had && run == 0, key = run)
    val stepNow by rememberUpdatedState(step)
    val enter = session.enterAt(1)
    LaunchedEffect(run) {
        if (run == 0 && Setup.check != null) return@LaunchedEffect
        Setup.check = null
        snapshotFlow { stepNow }.first { it >= enter }
        // The install deletes the staged copy, so a Recheck after it stages again
        val bin = Setup.staged?.takeIf { it.exists() } ?: stageBinary(context)?.also { Setup.staged = it }
        val (report, r) = bin?.let { readCheckReport(it.absolutePath) }
            ?: (emptyList<String>() to Result.failure(IllegalStateException("no usb-arsenal binary for ${Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS.firstOrNull()}")))
        // A check that could not finish says why in the shell, under what it printed
        Setup.report = report + listOfNotNull(r.exceptionOrNull()?.let { it.message ?: "check failed" })
        Setup.check = r
        r.getOrNull()?.let { Gadget.caps = it; Cache.caps = it }
    }
    val caps = result?.getOrNull()
    // Done only once the report has typed, so the keys never run ahead of what the shell says
    val done = result != null && step >= total
    val canNext = done && caps?.requirementsMet == true
    LaunchedEffect(done) { if (done && !canNext && (run > 0 || !had)) haptics.reject() }
    // Back leaves until check starts; one that is running finishes first, quick and in our own root shell
    BackHandler { if (done || stepNow < enter) back() }
    val focus = focusOn(done)
    Screen(
        footer = {
            KeyRow {
                if (setup) {
                    Key(
                        "Recheck",
                        Modifier.weight(1f).then(if (done && !canNext) Modifier.focusRequester(focus) else Modifier),
                        enabled = done,
                    ) { run++ }
                    Key(
                        "Next",
                        Modifier.weight(1f).then(if (canNext) Modifier.focusRequester(focus) else Modifier),
                        primary = true,
                        enabled = canNext,
                        onClick = next,
                    )
                } else {
                    Key("Done", Modifier.weight(1f).focusRequester(focus), primary = true, enabled = done, onClick = back)
                }
            }
        },
    ) {
        Top { if (setup) Steps(setupSteps() - 1, setupSteps()) else BackKey(enabled = done || step < enter) }
        Title("Check")
        Shell("sh", if (!done) Led.BUSY else if (canNext) Led.ON else Led.OFF, session.shownAt(step), Modifier.fill(min = 200.dp))
    }
}

// What the install looks like from the shell; the app runs the installer itself (backend/Installer.kt)
private const val INSTALL = "./install-backend.sh"

/*
 * The ported installer, played as a root shell like Root's. A comment says what will be
 * installed and the command types at once: nothing is asked, as opening the screen (setup's
 * Next, Home's update, Settings' Reinstall) already was. The installer's lines are its output,
 * typed as they come, and the prompt comes back. The layout never changes. [update] is the
 * installed version when this replaces one; the app's own version needs no root.
 */
@Composable
private fun InstallScreen(setup: Boolean, update: String?, back: () -> Unit, home: () -> Unit) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val haptics = LocalHaptics.current
    val phase = Setup.phase
    val log = Setup.log
    val ended = phase == Phase.DONE || phase == Phase.FAILED
    val version = BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME
    val arch = deviceArch() ?: Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS.firstOrNull().orEmpty()
    val opening = buildList {
        if (update != null) {
            // The same version rebuilt is still an update, but "1.2.0 → 1.2.0" would say nothing
            add(ShellLine("# ", if (update != version) "# update $update → $version" else "# usb-arsenal $version for $arch"))
            // The install never touches the gadget, so this holds
            add(ShellLine("# ", "# the gadget stays up while it updates"))
        } else {
            add(ShellLine("# ", "# usb-arsenal $version for $arch"))
        }
    }
    val session = opening + when {
        phase == Phase.BEFORE -> listOf(ShellLine("# "))
        // One stream of output: it types straight through, with no beat between its lines
        ended -> listOf(ShellLine("# ", INSTALL, log.toList(), block = true), ShellLine("# "))
        else -> listOf(ShellLine("# ", INSTALL, log.toList(), block = true))
    }
    val total = session.steps()
    val step = rememberTyped(total, 1, instant = ended, key = Setup.retries)
    val stepNow by rememberUpdatedState(step)
    val enter = session.enterAt(opening.size)
    // Done only once everything has typed, so the keys never run ahead of what the shell says
    val finished = ended && step >= total

    LaunchedEffect(phase, Setup.retries) {
        if (phase != Phase.TYPING) return@LaunchedEffect
        // The installer starts the moment the command has typed, as Enter would
        snapshotFlow { stepNow }.first { it >= enter }
        Setup.install(context)
    }

    // Halfway through, Back would leave a module that is half copied
    BackHandler {
        when {
            !finished && phase != Phase.BEFORE -> {}
            phase == Phase.DONE -> home()
            else -> back()
        }
    }
    // The haptic belongs to an install seen ending here, not to a screen that opens on an old one
    var watching by remember { mutableStateOf(phase == Phase.TYPING || phase == Phase.RUNNING) }
    // Opening the screen was the ask: the command types at once
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        if (Setup.phase != Phase.BEFORE) return@LaunchedEffect
        watching = true
        Setup.enter()
    }
    LaunchedEffect(finished) {
        if (!finished || !watching) return@LaunchedEffect
        watching = false
        if (phase == Phase.DONE) haptics.confirm() else haptics.reject()
    }
    val focus = focusOn(phase to finished)
    val led = when {
        phase == Phase.BEFORE -> Led.OFF
        !finished -> Led.BUSY
        phase == Phase.DONE -> Led.ON
        else -> Led.OFF
    }

    Screen(
        footer = {
            KeyRow {
                val key = Modifier.weight(1f).focusRequester(focus)
                when {
                    phase == Phase.DONE && finished -> Key("Home", key, primary = true, onClick = home)
                    phase == Phase.FAILED && finished -> {
                        Key("Copy log", Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            context.getSystemService(ClipboardManager::class.java)
                                .setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("install log", log.joinToString("\n")))
                        }
                        Key("Retry", key, primary = true) {
                            watching = true
                            Setup.retries++
                            Setup.enter()
                        }
                    }
                    // Where Home will be, dashed until the install has ended
                    else -> Key("Home", Modifier.weight(1f), primary = true, enabled = false) {}
                }
            }
        },
    ) {
        // Back is there from the start, dashed while the install runs, so nothing pops in
        Top {
            if (setup) Steps(setupSteps(), setupSteps())
            else BackKey(enabled = finished || phase == Phase.BEFORE)
        }
        Title("Backend")
        Shell("sh", led, session.shownAt(step), Modifier.fill(min = 200.dp))
    }
}

/*
 * Controller: this phone has more than one USB device controller, and the backend needs to be
 * told which on every command. Each is a row with Pin: happy where a host is talking to it,
 * dozing where nothing is, which is the clue to the one the cable is in. Next keeps the pick
 * and runs Check with it.
 */
@Composable
private fun ControllerScreen(setup: Boolean, back: () -> Unit, next: () -> Unit) {
    BackHandler(onBack = back)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    // Read again when the process was killed on this step, so its rows come back
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { if (Controller.udcs == null) Controller.refresh() }
    val udcs = Controller.udcs.orEmpty()
    var picked by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(Controller.picked) }
    var writing by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val shown = rememberTyped(udcs.size.coerceAtLeast(1), 1)
    val first = focusOn()
    Screen(
        footer = {
            KeyRow {
                Key("Next", Modifier.weight(1f), primary = true, enabled = !writing && udcs.any { it.name == picked }) {
                    // Into the setup, through the binary at hand: the staged one before the
                    // backend is installed, since Check runs that
                    writing = true
                    scope.launch {
                        val bin = if (setup) Setup.staged?.takeIf { it.exists() } ?: stageBinary(context)?.also { Setup.staged = it } else null
                        val r = Controller.set(picked!!, bin?.absolutePath ?: UA)
                        writing = false
                        if (!r.ok) return@launch
                        // Check's answer is for the controller it ran with
                        Setup.check = null
                        if (!setup) Gadget.readCheckOnce()
                        next()
                    }
                }
            }
        },
    ) {
        Top { if (setup) Steps(2, setupSteps()) else BackKey() }
        Title("Controller")
        Text("This phone has more than one USB controller. Pick the one your cable is in.", LcdType.data)
        Column(Modifier.bleed(10.dp).selectableGroup()) {
            udcs.forEachIndexed { i, udc ->
                val focus = if (i == 0) Modifier.focusRequester(first) else Modifier
                ControllerRow(udc, udc.name == picked, rule = i > 0, focus.drawnFrom(i, shown)) { picked = udc.name }
            }
        }
    }
}

// A controller as a Home-style row: Pin, its name, its state and what that means. Inverted while picked
@Composable
private fun ControllerRow(udc: Udc, picked: Boolean, rule: Boolean, modifier: Modifier, onPick: () -> Unit) {
    val interaction = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
    val focused by interaction.collectIsFocusedAsState()
    val pressed by interaction.collectIsPressedAsState()
    val haptics = LocalHaptics.current
    val ink = LocalLcd.current.ink
    val hint = when (udc.state) {
        // Only a computer configures a controller; a charger stops at powered
        "configured" -> "a computer is using it"
        "suspended" -> "plugged in, the computer is asleep"
        "attached", "powered", "default", "addressed" -> "plugged in, not set up by a computer"
        "not attached" -> "nothing plugged in"
        else -> null
    }
    Box(
        modifier
            // The 2dp rule between rows, as Home's
            .then(if (rule) Modifier.drawWithContent { drawContent(); drawRect(ink, size = Size(size.width, Lcd.pixel.toPx())) } else Modifier)
            .lcdClickable(interaction, outline = false, role = Role.RadioButton) {
                haptics.tick()
                onPick()
            }
            .semantics { selected = picked },
    ) {
        Inverted(picked || focused || pressed) {
            Row(
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = Lcd.row).background(LocalLcd.current.ground).padding(10.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.tight),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            ) {
                SpriteIcon(if (udc.state == "configured") Sprites.PinHappy else Sprites.PinBlink, 2.dp)
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Lcd.lines)) {
                    Text(udc.name, LcdType.labelStrong)
                    Text(udc.state.ifEmpty { "-" }, LcdType.data)
                    if (hint != null) Text(hint, LcdType.data)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```
